records.title: Affordable ChatGPT Plan for Everyday Users (¥500/month) / 月額500円の日常利用プラン提案
records.excerpt: Affordable ChatGPT Plan for Everyday Users (¥500/month) / 月額500円の日常利用プラン提案 - Feature requests - OpenAI Developer Community OpenAI Developer Community Affordable ChatGPT Plan for Everyday Users (¥500/month) / 月額500円の日常利用プラン提案 ChatGPT Feature requests apobking November 12, 2026, 3:32pm 1 I am a 61-year-old ChatGPT user in Japan. I retired in October 2026 and now live without employment income. The Free plan feels too restrictive, while Go and Plus offer more features than I need. I mainly use ChatGPT for retirement planning, personal finances, finding a home, health management, food reviews, and everyday questions. What I value most is having someone I can continue to consult with who understands my circumstances and remembers our previous conversations. I make my own decisions. I do not want AI to decide for me. I value it as a continuing consultation partner. A potential new market Born in the 1960s, my generation adapted from an analog world to word processors, PCs, the internet, smartphones, and now AI. Some retirees are comfortable with technology but cannot justify expensive AI subscriptions. This need also extends to younger people who use AI mainly for everyday life rather than work. My proposal Offer an everyday-use ChatGPT plan for approximately ¥500/month , including: Sufficient everyday conversations Reliable long-term memory and conversational continuity Basic screenshot and file analysis Occasional web searches Advanced reasoning, image/video generation, and professional productivity tools could be excluded. Lightweight models and reasonable usage limits could help control costs. This could convert Free users who currently find paid plans unsuitable into new paying customers, rather than simply replacing existing Plus subscriptions. I recently reached the Free plan’s file-upload limit while preparing this very proposal and used a Plus trial to continue. This illustrates the gap I am describing. I am not asking for a cheaper version of everything. I am asking for an affordable AI consultation partner that people can keep using throughout their everyday lives. 日本語での提案概要 私は61歳で、2026年10月に退職した日本のChatGPTユーザーです。 無料版では利用制限が厳しく、GoやPlusでは不要な機能が多いと感じています。 私が最も価値を感じるのは、 「過去の会話や自分の事情を理解し、継続的に相談できる相手が居る事 」です。AIに判断を任せるのではなく、自分で判断するための相談相手です。 1960年代生まれの私たちは、アナログからPC、インターネット、スマートフォン、生成AIへと適応してきました。こうした世代には、AIを使いこなせても高額な仕事向けプランを必要としない人がいます。 そこで、 月額500円程度の日常利用プラン を提案します。 日常会話、長期メモリ、基本的なファイル・画像の読み取り、必要に応じたWeb検索を重視し、高度な生成機能は省いても構いません。 これは単なる値下げではなく、現在の有料プランが合わない無料ユーザーを新たな有料顧客として迎える提案です。 日常生活の中で、無理なく長く使い続けられるAIの選択肢を、ぜひ検討していただきたいと思います。 Related topics Topic Replies Views Activity Proposal: Affordable Pro Lite, Pay-as-You-Grow and ChatGPT Family Plans Feature requests 0 41 November 1, 2026 Product Suggestion: An Affordable ChatGPT Pro Plan for Seniors Aged 75+ ChatGPT chatgpt 1 75 November 7, 2026 Suggestion: Add $5 & $10 Subscription Plans to Make ChatGPT More Accessible Feature requests 0 404 March 1, 2025 Feature Suggestion: A friendly companion Feature requests chatgpt 1 33 November 2, 2026 Proposal: More Flexible ChatGPT Plans Based on How People Use the Service Feature requests 0 29 October 17, 2026

records.title: Arm Stock Took a Hit Because Investors Fear Nvidia Might Poach Its CEO. Is It Time to Sell?
records.excerpt: Nvidia's board has reportedly approached Rene Haas about replacing Jensen Huang. So investors suddenly have to price in the risk of losing the leader behind its data center push. Shares of Arm Holdings ( ARM -4.63% ) fell about 5% to roughly $189 on Friday afternoon after the Financial Times reported that Nvidia 's ( NVDA -2.01% ) board had approached Arm CEO Rene Haas about succeeding Jensen Huang, who resigned as Nvidia's CEO on Thursday. Nvidia's board pushed back later in the day, saying it has not formally engaged with any potential candidates and called speculation about a successor premature, CNBC reported. So nothing is decided. But the report forced Arm investors to think about something they might not have yet considered: Arm without Haas. Image source: Getty Images. Why Haas matters so much to Arm Haas knows Nvidia well. Before joining Arm in 2013, he spent seven years at Nvidia as vice president and general manager of its computing products business, according to Arm's annual report. He became Arm's CEO in February 2022 and led it through its 2023 IPO. Under Haas, Arm has moved well beyond designing chips for smartphones. It now sells its own data center processor, the Arm AGI CPU, and the company says demand is "extremely strong." In its latest shareholder letter, Arm said it is increasingly confident the chip can generate up to $2 billion in revenue over its 2027 and 2028 fiscal years. Arm itself flags the risk of losing him. Its annual report says the company is "particularly dependent on our senior management team, including Mr. Haas." The business is in good shape Arm's most recent quarter, which ended Sept. 30, was its best second quarter ever. Revenue rose 27% from a year earlier to $1.44 billion. License revenue jumped 50% to $773 million, while royalty revenue grew 8% to $670 million, and data center royalties doubled. Arm also said its share of servers at the top cloud companies jumped from 15% in 2024 to more than 50% in 2025, and it expects that to top 60% by the end of 2026. Nvidia is part of that story: its Vera processor is built on Arm technology. Wall Street mostly liked the results. After the report, Piper Sandler called it a solid quarter and kept its Overweight rating, while JPMorgan said licensing strength offset softer smartphone royalties. TD Cowen said Arm's progress on supply gives it more confidence the AGI CPU can bring in closer to $2 billion in its first year than its original $1 billion goal. Most firms trimmed their price targets anyway, citing lower valuations across chip stocks. New targets range from $230 at Bank of America, which rates the stock Neutral, to $330 at Mizuho. That suggests there’s still plenty of upside from Arm’s current price of about $190. The risks for Arm investors A CEO exit would hurt, but Arm wouldn't be leaderless. SoftBank Group owns about 86% of Arm, so it would effectively pick the next CEO. That control could be a risk in itself, since small shareholders might have little say. Haas has also already split his time: since April, he has run SoftBank Group International part-time while remaining Arm's CEO. Valuation is the other worry. Analysts cut their targets this month because valuations across chip stocks are shrinking, rather than because of anything Arm did. If that trend continues, Arm's shares could keep sliding even while the business grows. Should you sell? Not on a single report. Nvidia's board says it hasn't formally engaged candidates, and Haas hasn't commented. Arm's growth comes from the whole industry building on its designs, and that won't change overnight. If you own Arm, watch for any statement from Arm or SoftBank about Haas's plans. If you've wanted to own one of the best-positioned semiconductor stocks for the AI era, a dip driven by headlines rather than the business may be worth a closer look. Just keep the position manageable enough to ride out the uncertainty. Where to invest $1,000 right now When our analyst team has a stock tip, it can pay to listen. records.title: Honda Is Spending $3 Billion on a New Ohio Plant. Here’s What It Means for Investors.
records.excerpt: Honda Motor ( HMC +2.30% ) is spending $3 billion on a new manufacturing plant in central Ohio that will produce up to 240,000 vehicles annually and create more than 2,000 jobs. The facility is expected to begin production in 2029, bringing Honda's total U.S. manufacturing capacity to approximately 1.3 million vehicles annually. Interestingly, Honda isn't building this factory for just electric vehicles. Instead, it plans to manufacture gasoline-powered vehicles, hybrids, and fully electric vehicles at the same facility. And it's a strategy that could serve the company well over the next decade. Image source: Getty Images. Honda is putting more money into hybrids Honda is investing heavily in hybrid technology as consumer demand for fully electric vehicles grows more slowly than previously anticipated. The company plans to introduce 15 new Honda and Acura hybrid models globally by 2030. It is also upgrading existing manufacturing facilities, including plans to increase the production capacity of its hybrid systems at its Ohio transmission plant by 250%. The appeal of hybrids is fairly obvious. They offer better fuel economy than conventional gasoline vehicles without requiring drivers to worry about charging stations or driving range. For consumers who aren't ready to make the switch to fully electric vehicles, hybrids offer a practical alternative. And for Honda, stronger hybrid sales could help support profitability as the electric vehicle market continues to develop. The transition to electric vehicles is still happening Honda's renewed emphasis on hybrids doesn't mean the transition to electric vehicles has stopped. EV adoption continues expanding in major markets, particularly China and Europe. Battery costs have generally declined over time, charging infrastructure continues to improve, and automakers are developing more affordable electric models. Of course, the transition isn't happening as quickly as many manufacturers originally expected. But over the next decade, Honda will still need to compete in an increasingly electrified automobile market. That's one reason the flexibility of its new Ohio factory is appealing. Honda won't be locked into producing only gas-powered cars or hybrids. It'll have the ability to manufacture fully electric vehicles as demand increases. Still, manufacturing flexibility alone won't guarantee success. Honda will need competitive batteries, electric powertrains, and software to compete with established EV manufacturers. In Q2, operating profit declined 39% to $746 million, partly reflecting substantial restructuring costs for its EV business. That said, management still raised its full-year operating profit forecast by 20% to $4.93 billion, supported by stronger hybrid demand and favorable currency movements. Honda also continues to face challenges in China, where competition from domestic electric vehicle manufacturers has intensified. The new Ohio factory won't begin producing vehicles until 2029, so don't expect any kind of immediate financial benefit, either. But I must admit that I do like the flexibility Honda is building into its manufacturing operations. Indeed, hybrids could provide an important source of earnings over the next several years, while the ability to produce EVs gives Honda room to adapt as the market evolves. Just be aware that outside of the U.S., the EV market continues to grow rapidly. And that means Honda can't afford to become so focused on today's hybrid demand that it falls behind in tomorrow's electric vehicle market. records.excerpt: Honda Motor stock enters the session after Honda raised its FY2027 operating-profit outlook. EV restructuring costs weighed on second-quarter earnings. HMC , US4381283088 Honda Motor stock: Outlook raised despite EV restructuring costs Published on 11/13/2026 at 20:41 | Editorial responsibility: Rafael Müller, Editor-in-Chief AD HOC NEWS Honda Motor stock enters the session after Honda raised its FY2027 operating-profit outlook. EV restructuring costs weighed on second-quarter earnings. Outlook improves despite costly EV reset Honda raised its fiscal 2027 operating-profit forecast to 780 billion yen from 650 billion yen. First-half operating profit reached 648.7 billion yen, while EV-related costs reduced the reported result. A new Ohio plant is planned to support North American hybrid production from 2029. HMC, US4381283088, Illustration mit AI erstellt. Honda Motor raised its full-year operating-profit forecast on November 10, 2026, as strong North American hybrid demand and motorcycle earnings helped offset heavy costs from its electric-vehicle restructuring. Reuters reported that the company lifted its fiscal 2027 operating-profit forecast to 780 billion yen from 650 billion yen. Honda booked 484.8 billion yen in EV-related restructuring costs during the July-to-September quarter. Quarterly operating profit fell 39 percent year over year to 118 billion yen, below the 250 billion yen median estimate in an LSEG poll cited by Reuters. First-half performance stays resilient For the six months ended September 30, Honda reported operating profit of 648.7 billion yen. The automaker's first-half results also benefited from robust motorcycle sales and higher North American vehicle volumes, while management cautioned that some one-time gains would not recur in the second half. Honda raised its full-year global vehicle sales forecast less favorably, cutting the target by 7 percent to 3.16 million vehicles, mainly because of weaker demand in China. It also expects somewhat tougher North American conditions as higher interest rates and incentives weigh on the market. Ohio plant targets hybrid demand Honda plans to build a 3 billion US dollar auto plant in Ohio with annual capacity for 240,000 hybrid vehicles. Production is expected to begin in 2029, supporting the company's shift toward hybrids in the US market. Or sign-in if you have an account. 2023 Honda Pilot TrailSport Photo by Honda Article content Honda is recalling more than 635,000 vehicles in the U.S. because of a software defect that could lead to sudden power steering loss. Specifically, the National Highway Traffic and Safety Administration’s safety campaign covers 75,598 examples of the Acura TLX sedan from model years 2021 to 2025; another 177,100 examples of the Acura MDX SUV from 2022 through 2024; and some 383,110 Honda Pilot SUVs from 2023 to 2025. Transport Canada has not yet made public an equivalent recall, so it’s unclear how many, if any, vehicles are affected in Canada. Article content The defect regards a few bad lines of code in the vehicles’ software, an issue first reported to the automaker back in November 2021; Honda has spent years tracking down the specific problem, and has only now found a remedy. To get into the nitty-gritty, the Driver Attention Monitor in these vehicles – designed to detect whether a driver is beginning to nod off – has a road-condition compensation calculation, to differentiate between, for example, a road with a crown in it versus a sleepy driver sawing the wheel back and forth. The real problem, though, is that the code was written so that when the software bumped up against this logical impossibility, it would decide to shut off the main steering assist. And that’s not good. Article content The fault occurs only when the vehicle is being driven straight; what will happen is that the driver will get an EPS (electronic power steering) warning light show up on the dashboard, and notice their Acura or Honda’s steering has suddenly got a lot heavier. records.title: Thousands of Honda and Acura vehicles are being recalled in Canada. Here’s why
records.excerpt: A recall notice has been issued for nearly 43,000 Honda and Acura vehicles due to a software problem that could lead to a surprise increase in steering effort. A recall notice has been issued for nearly 43,000 Honda and Acura vehicles due to a software problem that could lead to a surprise increase in steering effort. The recall applies to Acura’s 2022-24 MDX models and their 2021-25 TLX vehicles, along with the Honda Pilot’s 2023-2025 cars. “A software problem in the electronic power steering (EPS) control unit could cause the EPS system to enter a failsafe mode. If this happens, there could be a sudden increase in steering effort,” the recall notice said. It was first published in October and updated Friday. They warn that a sudden need for steering effort could increase the risk of a crash. Electronic power steering acts as a mechanical assist allowing drivers to more easily direct the vehicle. The control unit acts interfaces between the driver with the steering wheel and the vehicle’s larger steering system. “This system gives the driver an enjoyable driving experience and easier maneuverability, while also enhancing fuel efficiency,” Honda said on their website. The amount of assist the system provides changes, which Honda said helps save fuel. It increases at low speeds for more detailed manoeuvres and decreases at high speeds like when driving down the highway. Honda said it will notify owners of affected vehicles by mail and is advising them to their vehicle to a dealership to receive a software update. Owners can input their Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) into the firm’s website to determine if their particular vehicle is affected. A car’s VIN can be found on the driver’s side door, on the windshield or on the registration, the company advised.

Earnings are expected to improve, with Honda Motor forecast to report a statutory profit of JP¥167 per share. In the lead-up to this report, the analysts had been modelling revenues of JP¥24t and earnings per share (EPS) of JP¥156 in 2027. So the consensus seems to have become somewhat more optimistic on Honda Motor's earnings potential following these results. See our latest analysis for Honda Motor There's been no major changes to the consensus price target of JP¥1,840, suggesting that the improved earnings per share outlook is not enough to have a long-term positive impact on the stock's valuation. The consensus price target is just an average of individual analyst targets, so - it could be handy to see how wide the range of underlying estimates is. Currently, the most bullish analyst values Honda Motor at JP¥2,300 per share, while the most bearish prices it at JP¥1,400. This shows there is still a bit of diversity in estimates, but analysts don't appear to be totally split on the stock as though it might be a success or failure situation. Looking at the bigger picture now, one of the ways we can make sense of these forecasts is to see how they measure up against both past performance and industry growth estimates. It's pretty clear that there is an expectation that Honda Motor's revenue growth will slow down substantially, with revenues to the end of 2027 expected to display 3.7% growth on an annualised basis. This is compared to a historical growth rate of 10.0% over the past five years. Compare this to the 10 other companies in this industry with analyst coverage, which are forecast to grow their revenue at 3.1% per year. So it's pretty clear that, while Honda Motor's revenue growth is expected to slow, it's expected to grow roughly in line with the industry. records.title: Honda’s healthy bike sales result in big net income increase
records.excerpt: Honda Motor Co.’s net profit soared 66% in the first half of its fiscal year, largely due to its strong motorcycle sales, the Japanese manufacturer and the Associated Press reported. Honda's luxury to Honda Motor Co.’s net profit soared 66% in the first half of its fiscal year, largely due to its strong motorcycle sales, the Japanese manufacturer and the Associated Press reported. Honda's luxury touring bike, the Gold Wing, remains the manufacturer's flagship model. (File photo) Honda reported net income of $3.3 billion for the six months through September, up from $1.95 billion during the same period last year. First-half sales rose 13% to $75.15 billion, up from $66.38 billion. The strong financial first half came despite Honda’s electric vehicle program struggling. The manufacturer recently dropped some models. Honda said EV-related losses erased $3.04 billion from its operating profits. But on the powersports side, it’s still unclear when Honda’s EV concept models — the EV Fun and EV Urban — will hit dealerships. Both concepts were unveiled during EICMA 2024, and reports say the EV Fun began production earlier this year. No production date has been set for the EV Urban. Honda seems to be sticking with its stressed that Honda expects battery EVs might eventually become more popular, and it will remain flexible enough to switch to EV production in the future. Honda also reported it raised its full-year operating profit forecast to $4.88 billion from $4.07 billion. It attributed the increased forecast to better exchange rates and efforts to reduce the impact of U.S. tariffs, including shifting production to the U.S. The company also plans to expand motorcycle production at its Manaus factory in Brazil, increasing capacity to 2.3 million motorcycles by 2029, up from 1.6 million currently. Honda’s motorcycle division set a first-half sales record, with models proving popular in Brazil and India. It sold 11.9 million motorcycles during the six months, up from nearly 10.8 million the previous year.

records.excerpt: Toyota and Honda Sales Decline Despite 41% YoY Jump in Pakistan Car Market News Guides Comparisons Specs & Price Toyota and Honda Sales Decline Despite 41% YoY Jump in Pakistan Car Market By ProPK Staff | Published Nov 12, 2026 | 11:31 pm Pakistan’s overall car sales jumped sharply in October 2026, but Toyota and Honda moved in the opposite direction as both automakers recorded year-on-year declines. According to the latest Pakistan Automotive Manufacturers Association (PAMA) data, car sales reached 24,418 units in October, up 41% year-on-year (YoY) and 62% month-on-month (MoM), Topline Securities has reported. Toyota Sales Fall 10% Indus Motor Company (INDU), which manufactures Toyota vehicles in Pakistan, sold 4,078 units during October, down 10% YoY and 2% MoM. Combined sales of the Toyota Corolla, Yaris and Corolla Cross fell 7% YoY to 3,496 units, while Fortuner and IMV sales declined 27% YoY to 577 units. Honda Records Bigger Decline Honda Atlas Cars (HCAR) reported sales of 2,101 units, representing a 19% YoY decline and a 1% MoM decrease. Honda City and Civic sales stood at 1,933 units, down 14% YoY and 4% MoM. Meanwhile, combined BR-V and HR-V sales fell sharply by 53% YoY to 168 units. The declines came despite strong growth in the wider auto market, which Topline said was primarily driven by Pakistan Suzuki Motor Company (PSMC). Suzuki sold 15,921 vehicles during October, up 115% YoY and nearly 3.3 times MoM. The Alto and Swift also posted record monthly sales of 11,363 units and 3,214 units, respectively. records.excerpt: ホンダ「ヴェゼルRS」先行予約開始 SUV初の「Honda S＋ Shift」搭載へ 11/13(金) 10:50 配信 “プレリュード譲り”の新システム初搭載 ホンダは2026年11月12日、コンパクトSUV「ヴェゼル」のスポーティモデル「e：HEV RS」に関する先行情報を公式サイトで公開し、先行予約の受付を開始しました。 【画像】これが新たな「ヴェゼル RS」です！ 画像を見る（30枚以上） 今冬の登場を予定している新たなヴェゼル e：HEV RSでは、SUVとして初めて新しい走行制御技術「Honda S＋ Shift（ホンダ エスプラスシフト）」を採用します。 「ヴェゼルRS」先行予約開始（画像：ティザーサイトより）（くるまのニュース） ヴェゼルは、クーペのような流麗なデザインと広い室内空間を両立したコンパクトSUVです。現行モデルは2021年4月に登場した2代目にあたります。 2026年10月23日にはマイナーモデルチェンジが実施され、「e：HEV Z」などの上級グレードでは、ホイールアーチやバンパーガーニッシュをボディ同色に変更。より都会的で洗練された外観に仕上げるとともに、一部グレードでは快適装備も充実させました。 そして、ヴェゼル e：HEV RSは、2025年10月に追加されたスポーティグレードです。「URBAN SPORT VEZEL」をコンセプトに、専用の内外装や足回りを採用し、走る楽しさを追求したモデルとして登場しました。 今回公開された新たなヴェゼル e：HEV RSで、最大の注目ポイントとなるのがHonda S＋ Shiftの採用です。 Honda S＋ Shiftは、ホンダの2モーターハイブリッドシステム「e：HEV」に組み合わされる新たなパワーユニット制御技術です。2025年に登場したスポーツクーペ「プレリュード」で初採用され、その後「シビック e：HEV RS」にも展開。今回はSUVであるヴェゼル e：HEV RSにも搭載されることになりました。 この技術は、実際に多段変速機を搭載するのではなく、エンジンとモーターを緻密に制御することで、有段変速機のような変速フィールを生み出すものです。 加速時だけでなく減速時にもエンジン回転数と駆動力を段階的に変化させることで、ドライバーの操作に応じた小気味よい変速フィールと優れた応答性を実現し、クルマを操る楽しさを高めています。 さらにヴェゼル e：HEV RSのティザーサイトでは、専用のボタンを押すことでアクセル操作に鋭く反応する爽快な走りへと変化し、実際のエンジンサウンドとともにスポーティなドライブを楽しめることが紹介されています。 また、ヴェゼル e：HEV RSは外観にもスポーティな専用デザインを採用しています。ロー＆ワイドなスタイルを特徴とし、足元にはマットベルリナブラック仕上げの18インチアルミホイールを装着。ブラッククロームメッキのエンブレムも採用し、引き締まった印象を強めています。 足回りにはRS専用のローダウンサスペンションを採用。従来のe：HEV RSでも、標準モデルより車高を15mm低くすることで、安定感のある走りと軽快なハンドリングを実現していました。 インテリアもRS専用の仕立てとなり、身体をしっかりと支えるフロントスポーツシートを装備。さらにステンレス製スポーツペダルを採用するなど、運転する楽しさを演出する装備が盛り込まれています。 なお、従来のe：HEV RSには、1.5リッターエンジンと2モーターハイブリッドシステムを組み合わせたパワートレインを搭載し、FFに加えて4WDも設定されていました。 新たなヴェゼル e：HEV RSの詳しいスペックや車両価格、正式な発売日については、今回の先行情報サイトでは明らかにされていません。 ※ ※ ※ また、同サイトではアウトドア志向の新タイプ「ヴェゼル e：HEV TRAILSPORT（トレイルスポーツ）」も公開され、こちらにもHonda S＋ Shiftが搭載されます。 走りの楽しさを追求したヴェゼル e：HEV RSが、新技術の採用によってどのように進化するのか、正式発表が期待されます。 くるまのニュース編集部 【関連リンク】 【画像】これが新たな「ヴェゼル RS」です！ 画像を見る トヨタ「セリカ」20年ぶりに車名復活！ 新型「GRセリカ records.title: Honda’s new era is almost here, with this updated SUV leading the way
records.excerpt: Title: Honda’s new era is almost here, with this updated SUV leading the way URL Source: http://www.autoexpress.co.uk/honda/cr-v/370896/honda-cr-v-all-set-dramatic-overhaul-2027 Final URL: https://www.autoexpress.co.uk/honda/cr-v/370896/honda-cr-v-all-set-dramatic-overhaul-2027 Published Time: 2026-11-12T15:50:18+00:00 Markdown Content: ## Honda CR-V is all set for a dramatic overhaul in 2027 ## The next-gen Honda CR-V is going to represent a total change from today’s model – and more details are emerging ![Image 1](https://images.autoexpress.co.uk/autoexpress/dsc_7774.jpg?w=104&h=104&fit=crop&crop=faces&q=75&auto=format%2Ccompress&dpr=1) 12 Nov 2026 ![Image 2: Honda CR-V Teaser](https://images.autoexpress.co.uk/autoexpress/2026/11/Honda%20CR-V%20Teaser.jpg?w=375&h=210&fit=crop&auto=format%2Ccompress&dpr=1) Honda is readying a new generation of models for its new hybrid era, and the most important of them all has just been previewed. An all-new [Honda CR-V](https://www.autoexpress.co.uk/honda/cr-v), with a new design language, new technology package and an even [more efficient Honda Hybrid powertrain](https://www.autoexpress.co.uk/honda/367015/new-honda-hybrid-be-worlds-most-efficient-powertrain-and-feature-15-new-cars) is coming soon – we’ll just have to wait our turn in the UK and Europe. Advertisement - Article continues below As the Japanese company’s global highest seller, this will be one of the first models to undergo such a substantial overhaul across the board. Until now it has been previewed only by a badge sporting a new font, but we know that Honda has been working on introducing some big changes from the car we know today. The first and most obvious will be a new design language, one that will shake off the solid, if slightly safe-edged look of today’s car for something more progressive and inspirational. Honda has already previewed what this new language could look like in a couple of other forms, starting with the [Honda hybrid saloon concept](https://www.autoexpress.co.uk/honda/369593/new-honda-hybrid-saloon-and-suv-prototypes-fill-0-series-sized-hole-after-ev-u-turn) that was revealed earlier this year. This far more angular styling didn’t just sit on top of familiar proportions, but shaped the car’s elegant fastback shape that Honda’s been working on for a few of its future models. [Skip advert](https://www.autoexpress.co.uk/honda/cr-v/370896/honda-cr-v-all-set-dramatic-overhaul-2027#skip-to-div-mwhnenp6) Advertisement - Article continues below However, a more relevant teaser could be the [Avancier](https://www.autoexpress.co.uk/honda/370850/new-honda-avancier-cutting-edge-family-suv-rival-hyundai-santa-fe-and-skoda-kodiaq) that’ll be sold in some overseas markets. This previewed an ultra-clean[SUV](https://www.autoexpress.co.uk/best/suvs) shape and hi-tech details like flush LED lighting and new badging – all elements that we’re expecting to see on the new CR-V. Advertisement - Article continues below Honda will also introduce the Asimo infotainment system. This is a far more advanced set-up that, as is the case on many European rivals, combines all the digital systems of the car into one or two completely connected interfaces. These also run on something much closer to a software-defined electrical architecture, giving it a more robust connection to online services and by extension the ability to be given Tesla-like software updates over the air. ![Image 3: Honda CR-V front tracking](https://images.autoexpress.co.uk/Honda%20CR-V-2.jpg?w=375&h=210&fit=crop&q=75&auto=format%2Ccompress&dpr=1) Finally, the new CR-V should also be one of the first cars to benefit from the new Honda Hybrid system. This new tech has been designed to deliver greater efficiency than the current car, with electric motors responsible for a majority of the drive, and the petrol engine instead working more as a generator. However, whether the CR-V that we will see in the next few months includes this technology from the off remains to be seen. That’s because it will first be revealed in its American specification. records.excerpt: シェア: ジャカルタ - ホンダは、110ccエンジンを搭載したスクーターと同等の能力を持つ毎日の通勤用車両として設計された電気スクーターUC3を発表しました。このモデルは、最大速度約80km/h、1回の充電で最大122kmの走行距離を提供します。 Honda UC3は、最大6 kWまたは約8馬力のモーターを使用しています。この電力は、特に高速走行を必要としない毎日の旅行のために、都市モビリティのニーズに供給されます。 この電気バイクには、3.2kWhの容量のリチウム鉄リン酸塩(LFP)バッテリーが搭載されています。世界オートバイテストサイクル(WMTC)規格によるテストに基づいて、ホンダUC3は、バッテリーが完全に充電されている状態で最大122kmの距離を走行できると主張されています。 バッテリーを取り外す電気スクーターとは異なり、ホンダUC3バッテリーは車両に永久的に取り付けられています。ユーザーは、モーターに搭載されている充電システムを介して直接充電する必要があります。 機能面では、Honda UC3にはカラーTFTインストルメントパネルとスマートフォンの接続が装備されています。ドライバーはまた、3つの運転モードと、限られたスペースでの操作を支援するための逆ギヤ機能を利用できます。 ジョックの下の収納容量は26リットルに達します。このスペースは、運転手の毎日の必需品を保管するために使用できます。 ベトナムでは、ホンダUC3は7850万ベトナムドン(約5570万ルピア)で販売されています。しかし、ディーラーからのいくつかのオファーは、価格を約5400万ドン(約3830万ルピア)に引き下げました。 比較のために、価格は初期価格で約3,000米ドルまたは約5450万ルピアに相当し、割引価格は約2,100米ドルまたは3810万ルピアです。ルピアの計算は2026年11月12日の参照レートを使用して行われ、為替レートに従って変更される可能性があります。 多くの東南アジア諸国で販売されているにもかかわらず、ホンダは近い将来にUC3を米国に持ち込む計画を発表していない。この国のマーケティング機会は、異なるオートバイ市場の特性のために課題に直面していると見なされています。 東南アジアでは、小型スクーターは日常生活のモビリティのための主要な選択肢の1つです。一方、米国オートバイ市場はレクリエーション車両に大きく焦点を当てており、実用的なニーズのための小型スクーターセグメントは比較的限られています。 消費者の性格の違いに加えて、米国でのUC3のマーケティングには、認証要件、スペアパーツのサポート、アフターサービスネットワークの達成も必要です。この市場の消費者は、高速道路での使用のための速度を含む、車両の能力にも異なる期待を持っています。 したがって、Honda UC3は、コンパクトなスクーターに強い需要がある市場での都市モビリティのニーズをより重視しています。しかし、同社は、販売のターゲットとなっている国々以外でのモデルのマーケティング計画を発表していない。 The English, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, and French versions are automatically generated by the AI. records.title: 2027 Acura Integra Type S Turns Back the Clock with This New Retro-Themed Model
records.excerpt: Acura spruces up its sport compact and celebrates turning 30 with a special edition inspired by one of its most iconic cars. The 2027 Acura Integra Type S is getting some updates for the new model year, including a retro-themed Heritage Edition.The Integra Type S now has standard black wheels and yellow brake calipers; the interior adds dark accents, restyled dash trim, and updated upholstery options.The Heritage Edition wears exclusive Blazing Phoenix Yellow paint inspired by the iconic Integra Type R, which pairs with black badges and copper-colored wheels.When Acura revived the Integra nameplate several years ago, it heralded the return of one of the brand’s most iconic models. When the more powerful Type S variant joined the party, Acura could finally offer a true performance-focused car for the first time in years. The new Integra Type S also brought back memories of the legendary DC2 Type R that was sold in America from 1997–2001. For the 2027 model year, Acura is celebrating its 30th anniversary by paying homage to that classic with a new Integra Type S Heritage Edition.Before we get into the details about the Heritage Edition, let’s talk about the changes Acura has made to the standard ‘27 Type S. Every example now features gloss-black 19-inch wheels and mirror caps, and the Brembo-branded brake calipers are now painted yellow. There are no powertrain changes, so a rowdy 320-hp 2.0-liter turbo four and sweet-shifting six-speed manual transmission still feed the front wheels.Inside, Acura now makes the door-panel trim, door handles, and shift boot dark gray, and that applies to the dashboard too, which also adopts a new diamond pattern. The three knobs that control the climate settings are now all gloss black, and Acura says it has redesigned the upholstery options. The Red and Orchid (white) themes feature faux-suede accents that are black and blue, respectively, but the Ebony option features yellow stitching, which extends to the steering wheel, door panels, and shift boot. The driver’s seat now has memory settings, as does the brake-hold feature, and both exterior mirrors tilt down when the car is put into reverse.If you missed your chance to buy a Phoenix Yellow Integra Type R back in the day, Acura is turning back the clock and giving you another shot. Sure, the new Type S model has an extra pair of doors and put on some weight, but it remains one of our favorite driver’s cars, and the Heritage Edition is the only way to get the new Blazing Phoenix Yellow paint job (at least for the ‘27 model year). Not only is the new retro-themed Type S the first Integra with yellow paint since the 2001 Type R, but it also features exclusive copper-colored wheels. Its interior color is limited to the black-and-yellow theme offered on other new Type S models, but the Heritage Edition alone has a titanium shift knob—same as the Honda Civic Type R.Acura says the 2027 versions of the Integra Type S will reach dealerships sometime next month. While that includes the new Heritage Edition, it’s limited to just 700 examples for U.S. audiences. For those who are lucky enough to score one, it’s only $2300 more than the regular Type S, which starts at $55,995.➡️ Skip the lot. records.title: Honda CVT Transmission Problems: The Years and Models to Watch
records.excerpt: Honda's CVT transmissions are known for their seamless acceleration and great fuel efficiency, but how do they rate in terms of durability? Honda CVT Transmission Problems: The Years and Models to Watch Autoblog John Tallodi Sat, November 14, 2026 at 4:00 PM UTC Sat, November 14, 2026 at 4:00 PM UTC Autoblog and Yahoo may earn commission from links in this article. While designing your own transmission in-house may seem like the obvious route to go for major manufacturers, many outsource these components to third-party suppliers like Jatco. In fact, when it comes to CVTs, Nissan , Mitsubishi and Suzuki all use this supplier, but some, like Honda , have gone it alone for decades. We looked back at the development of Honda's CVT technology to see whether this strategy has paid off in terms of reliability. While the general consensus is that modern Honda CVTs are durable , their reliability record and common problems varies depending on which era we look at. The Multi Matic Years (1995–2012) Honda Honda first introduced CVTs in the US in the mid-1990s on models like the 1.6-liter Civic HX, followed by widespread use in early Integrated Motor Assist (IMA) hybrids like the Insight and Civic Hybrid. Advertisement Advertisement These early units utilized a wet start-clutch rather than a traditional torque converter to couple engine power to the transmission, and this was the primary point of failure. Over time, as the friction material wore out, it degraded the fluid causing severe low-speed shuddering or juddering when pulling away from a standstill. Honda issued technical service bulletins (TSBs) involving a "clutch burnishing" procedure and switched from generic automatic transmission fluid to specialized CVT fluid. While catastrophic mechanical failures (such as snapped push-belts) were relatively rare, drivability issues were common if the fluid was neglected. The Early Earth Dreams Era (2013–2015) Honda Around 2013, Honda began replacing conventional automatic transmissions with the Earth Dreams CVT across mainstream models, including gas-powered vehicles. These included the 9th-generation Accord (2013), as well as the Civic in 2014, And CR-V in 2015. This generation replaced the wet clutch with a traditional torque converter, vastly improving launch smoothness and low-speed responsiveness. Advertisement Advertisement Unfortunately, there was an early problem that put a dent in reliability. The primary drive pulley shaft on early production models could crack and snap, causing sudden loss of propulsion or front-wheel lockup. The issue was traced back to incorrectly configured transmission control software which resulted in a recall of around 143,000 2014–2015 Civics and 2015 Fits. A software update reprogrammed the Transmission Control Module (TCM) to lower peak hydraulic pressures, effectively resolving the stress fracture issue. Units that received the recall update early had a far lower failure rate, but those that never had the repair work carried out or have been neglected remain susceptible to fatigue failures. The Modern Era (2016–Present) Honda From the 10th-generation Civic onward, Honda refined its CVT design, with more robust materials, enhanced internal cooling and the welcome introduction of simulated shift mapping. These artificially programmed shifts helped alleviate some of the rubber-band drone effect when accelerating hard. CVT transmissions from this era tend to have very low failure catastrophic belt or pulley failures, especially when paired with naturally aspirated engines, like the 2.0-liter units in the Civic and the 2.4-liter engines used in the CR-V and Accord . Advertisement Advertisement CVTs are smooth and efficient, but they are not suited to high power or torque outputs, and these transmissions paired with the current generation 1.5-liter turbocharged engine can suffer from belt slip and accelerated transmission wear. While stock configurations remain dependable, aftermarket engine tuning is not recommended for transmission longevity. Certain Honda HR-V models built between 2016 and 2020 could suffer from premature deterioration of the heavy-duty internal steel push-belt that connects the CVT pulleys. With several vehicles experiencing failures at around the 100,000 mile mark, Honda extended the powertrain warranty specifically for this CVT belt issue to 7 years or 150,000 miles Honda e-CVT Hybrid Transmission Honda Honda markets some of its modern hybrid models with an e-CVT system. From a mechanical standpoint, the e-CVT is not a continuously variable transmission as it contains no steel belts, chains, cones, or variable pulleys. It consists of a direct-drive gearset and an electric generator/propulsion motor pairing. Because it eliminates the high-friction belt-and-pulley mechanism entirely, Honda's e-CVT has an exceptionally low failure rate and is significantly more durable than conventional mechanical CVTs. Honda CVT Failures and Maintenance Requirements Issue Typical Cause Resolution Low-speed Shudder / Judder Degraded Transmission Fluid Usually resolved by a drain-and-fill with OEM fluid. Whining Noise Under Acceleration Fluid degradation, clogged internal filter, or worn shaft bearings This can precede internal mechanical failure, but a fluid change can mitigate the symptoms. RPM Surge / Hesitation Belt slippage under load This may require a transmission rebuild/repair Like any moving part in a vehicle, your Honda's CVT transmission will eventually wear out. A measured driving style and regular maintenance can make a big difference in the overall longevity of your vehicle, as well as the CVT transmission. Advertisement Advertisement While several manufacturers claim that transmission fluid is good for the lifetime of a vehicle, independent specialists have found that regular fluid changes are necessary to maximize the lifespan of your CVT. Honda is one of the few manufacturers that recommends a fluid flush every 70,000-90,000 miles under normal driving conditions, or as often as every 25,000 to 35,000 miles under severe use. Specialists recommend the shorter interval regardless of the conditions, and OEM Honda transmission fluid is a must. Honda CVT Transmission Reliability Honda Stick to these guidelines and your Honda's CVT transmission should provide years of trouble-free service. According to long-term reliability survey data from J.D. Power and Kelley Blue Book , the majority of CVT-equipped Honda models score regularly above average in quality and reliability metrics, but regular servicing is always a must for best results. records.excerpt: Honda Is Opening In Lexington Park Dec. 15, And CMA Is Hiring - The BayNet Skip to content The BayNet Online News & Entertainment Members Sign In Home » Honda Is Opening In Lexington Park Dec. 15, And CMA Is Hiring Posted in Economy & Business Honda Is Opening In Lexington Park Dec. 15, And CMA Is Hiring by Jessica Jennings November 12, 2026 November 12, 2026 Share this: Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Email a link to a friend (Opens in new window) Email Photos courtesy of CMA Lexington Park Dealerships LEXINGTON PARK , Md. — Along Three Notch Road, where CMA’s Toyota of Lexington Park and CMA’s Hyundai of Lexington Park already welcome neighbors, a third showroom is getting ready to open its doors. Carter Myers Automotive will open CMA’s Honda of Lexington Park on Tuesday, Dec. 15, bringing a new Honda franchise to St. Mary’s County and adding a third store to the company’s Three Notch Road presence. The new store opens with a promise that is easy to state and harder to live up to: Fast, Friendly, Fair. “Fast, Friendly, Fair is not a tagline we hung on the wall,” said John Mark Osborne, executive manager of the Lexington Park stores. “It is what we hold our team to. Respect our customers’ time, treat them like neighbors, and do the right thing every time.” Owned By The People Who Serve You Behind the storefront is a company with deep roots. Carter Myers Automotive is a 100-year-old, employee-owned company operating 26 dealerships across four states. Through its employee stock ownership plan, CMA associates share in the ownership of the business, and the company’s culture phrase says it plainly: Owners Just Care More. “When the person writing your repair order and the person detailing your car are owners, the standard changes,” Osborne said. “That is not a slogan we printed on a wall. It is how the company is built.” The company’s tagline, Moving Lives Forward, applies to customers and associates alike. Photos courtesy of CMA Shop From Home Or In Store Whether a family prefers to sit down at the kitchen table or stop by the showroom, the store is built to treat both the same. Every vehicle at CMA’s Honda of Lexington Park carries competitive live market pricing, updated daily and posted online as well as on the lot. Customers can build a deal from their couch or walk in and work with a consultant face to face, with the same team, the same pricing and the same answers either way. Free Home Delivery, With No Conditions For those who would rather skip the trip altogether, the store will open with free home delivery. Customers within 30 miles can have a vehicle delivered the same day, and next-day delivery is available to the D.C. metro area. There is no fee and no minimum purchase, and the team will appraise a trade-in at the customer’s door. Buyers in Maryland, Virginia and Washington, D.C., are all welcome. Parts And Service Ready On Day One The store opens with a full Honda parts and service department, staffed by factory-trained technicians and ready to handle routine maintenance, warranty work and major repair. Customers of the Toyota and Hyundai stores already know the service team, and the Honda operation extends that capacity for Honda owners across Southern Maryland. Now Hiring Ahead Of Opening CMA’s Honda of Lexington Park has posted six job openings ahead of its Dec. 15 opening, with positions in service, parts, sales and finance. Job seekers can view all Lexington Park openings and apply through Carter Myers Automotive’s careers page. Photos courtesy of CMA Doors open Dec. 15. A public grand opening celebration will be announced soon. Rooted In Southern Maryland The Lexington Park stores have built a steady record of local giving, including classroom sponsorships and backpack drives for area schools, support for local food banks, hospice support, home repair for neighbors in need and help for families displaced by fire. The stores also work alongside a number of other community organizations across St. Mary’s County. That work continues this season. The stores are currently running a community bike drive for local youth programs, with a goal of donating 250 bicycles to kids who need a first set of wheels. CMA’s Honda of Lexington Park — Fast, Friendly, Fair. Moving Lives Forward. records.title: Thousands of Honda and Acura vehicles are being recalled in Canada. Here’s why
records.excerpt: A recall notice has been issued for nearly 43,000 Honda and Acura vehicles due to a software problem that could lead to a surprise increase in steering effort. A recall notice has been issued for nearly 43,000 Honda and Acura vehicles due to a software problem that could lead to a surprise increase in steering effort. The recall applies to Acura’s 2022-24 MDX models and their 2021-25 TLX vehicles, along with the Honda Pilot’s 2023-2025 cars. “A software problem in the electronic power steering (EPS) control unit could cause the EPS system to enter a failsafe mode. If this happens, there could be a sudden increase in steering effort,” the recall notice said. It was first published in October and updated Friday. They warn that a sudden need for steering effort could increase the risk of a crash. Electronic power steering acts as a mechanical assist allowing drivers to more easily direct the vehicle. The control unit acts interfaces between the driver with the steering wheel and the vehicle’s larger steering system. “This system gives the driver an enjoyable driving experience and easier maneuverability, while also enhancing fuel efficiency,” Honda said on their website. The amount of assist the system provides changes, which Honda said helps save fuel. It increases at low speeds for more detailed manoeuvres and decreases at high speeds like when driving down the highway. Honda said it will notify owners of affected vehicles by mail and is advising them to their vehicle to a dealership to receive a software update. Owners can input their Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) into the firm’s website to determine if their particular vehicle is affected. A car’s VIN can be found on the driver’s side door, on the windshield or on the registration, the company advised.

records.excerpt: Title: Honda recalls 635,808 vehicles over software that can cut steering assist on straight roads URL Source: http://www.thecooldown.com/green-tech/honda-steering-assist-recall-software-defect/ Final URL: https://www.thecooldown.com/green-tech/honda-steering-assist-recall-software-defect/ Published Time: 2026-11-14T08:27:00+00:00 Markdown Content: A software defect that can disable power steering assist during straight-line driving prompted Honda to recall 635,808 vehicles, [Torque News](https://www.torquenews.com/17998/honda-recalls-635808-pilot-acura-mdx-tlx-software-can-shut-off-power-steering-assist) reported, citing the company's Part 573 filing. An investigation continued for nearly five years before Honda initiated a recall. ### Here's what to know The recall covers 2023-25 Honda Pilot SUVs, 2022-24 Acura MDX SUVs, and 2021-25 Acura TLX sedans. Honda used manufacturing records to identify 383,110 Pilots, 177,100 MDXs, and 75,598 TLXs for the recall. The company estimates that all those vehicles have the affected software. As indicated in Honda's filing, the issue arises when the electric power steering software attempts a calculation that divides by zero, triggering an internal error. A second software mistake then causes the system to disable steering assist. In February, Honda confirmed that the problem occurs under certain operating conditions while driving straight. "If the EPS system enters failsafe mode, power steering assist is disabled, and the EPS warning indicators illuminate in the instrument cluster," the filing explained. "Without power assist, steering effort increases, which may reduce vehicle controllability, increasing the risk of a crash or injury." ### More background Honda first received a report of the issue Nov. 29, 2021, with additional reports arriving from August 2023 to August 2025. "Due to the deletion of error codes by the dealer or supplier, no issues were found with returned parts," Honda's filing explained. The supplier, Florence, Kentucky-based Robert Bosch Automotive Steering, identified the failure by analyzing returned parts Aug. 22, 2025. Honda then reproduced the problem in December 2025 using dashcam footage and analysis results. The company determined that a safety defect existed Oct. 22. The filing lists 146 warranty claims, one injury report, and no reported deaths from May 22, 2022, to Oct. 22, 2026. ### What's being done? The recall is listed under National Highway Traffic Safety Administration case 26V721 and Honda recalls KQB and TQA. Per Honda's filing and NHTSA's acknowledgment letter, authorized Honda and Acura dealers will reprogram the electric power steering control unit with improved software at no charge. Honda's filing set notification dates of around Oct. 30 for dealers and Dec. 14 for owners. Owners can check whether their vehicle identification number is affected at NHTSA.gov, according to the NHTSA's Monday acknowledgment letter. Drivers who experience increased steering effort alongside an electric power steering warning should contact a dealer rather than wait for a mailing. The recall does not include the 2025 Acura MDX or 2026 Honda Pilot, according to Honda's filing. Owners seeking help with the recall can contact Honda customer service at 1-866-784-1870. The NHTSA's acknowledgment letter also highlights the agency's Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 for vehicle safety questions. ### Where can I learn more? Other automakers have also recalled vehicles over steering problems and software glitches. These stories cover Volkswagen and Toyota recalls as well as a Ford Mustang issue. • Volkswagen recalled 2.86 million VW and Audi vehicles over a [potential loss of steering](https://learn.thecooldown.com/green-business/volkswagen-audi-recall-steering-screw-issue/). • Toyota recalled 10,000 electric C-HRs over a [software glitch that could cut power](https://learn.thecooldown.com/green-tech/toyota-electric-chr-recall-software-glitch/) while driving. • Ford recalled 148,000 Mustangs after a [wiring fault threatened power](https://learn.thecooldown.com/green-business/ford-mustang-recall-wiring-fault-power/), headlights, and air conditioning. records.title: Honda and Acura Brands Announce 635,808-Vehicle Recall To Address Software Issue
records.excerpt: Honda and Acura Brands Announce 635,808-Vehicle Recall To Address Software Issue - autoevolution autoevolution News Cars Database Driven Moto Database Game reviews EV/Hybrids Spyshots Space Junk Renderings Your Feed Compare Cars BAC Calculator Editorial Coverstory Motorsport Testdrives archive Auto Shows Tuning Car Finder Photo of the Day Glossary of automotive terms About us Team RSS Feeds Newsletter OS Default Light Dark EICMA 2026 • 2026 EICMA's Speed Legends Exhibit Was Not To Be Missed – See the Bikes That Paved MotoGP History • #honda pilot Honda and Acura Brands Announce 635,808-Vehicle Recall To Address Software Issue An error in the Driver Attention Monitor road-condition compensation calculation can leave drivers without power steering assistance Published: 12 Nov 2026, 19:08 UTC By: Mircea Panait 9 photos Photo: Acura American Honda Motor is recalling a whopping 635,808 automobiles in the United States market. An electronic power steering software error is capable of disabling power steering assistance without warning, increasing the risk of a crash. The problem affects three models, namely the discontinued TLX sedan, the MDX crossover, and the mechanically similar Pilot. Affected model years range from 2021 for the Acura TLX all the way to 2025 for the Honda Pilot. Referred to as 26V721 by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, this recall is designated KQB and TQA by the Japanese automaker. Not surprising in the least, the family-oriented Pilot crossover accounts for the majority of the recall population. 383,110 such vehicles are involved, while Acura contributed another 177,100 units of the MDX and 75,598 for the less popular TLX. When it comes to production timeframes, make that August 11, 2020, through December 23, 2025. Because it's very hard to find out when a subject vehicle has been produced, customers are better off simply checking the VIN against the NHTSA's database. American Honda Motor puts the blame on the software developed by Robert Bosch Automotive Steering LLC of Florence, Kentucky. The software in question contains an error in the Driver Attention Monitor's road-condition compensation calculation. Under specific operating conditions, the system may attempt a floating-point division by zero. I'm no math expert or computer scientist, but a quick search on Google reveals that downstream logic failures are possible. The EPS software responds to the calculation error by shutting down power steering assistance, thus entering failsafe mode. Drivers may retain the mechanical connection between the steering wheel and the front wheels, but no power assistance means a lot more muscle to turn the front wheels as intended. Photo: Acura Additional steering effort without warning is the kind of situation that greatly increases the risk of a crash, especially when cornering at high speeds. In the event of a power steering assistance malfunction, the EPS warning light illuminates. Honda started looking into this matter in November 2021, and more reports followed through August 2025. Engineers and technicians, however, struggled to pinpoint the root cause through returned components. Honda argues that dealers or the supplier had deleted the relevant error codes from returned parts. Bosch ultimately identified the problem in August 2025, then Honda recreated the issue in December 2025. Back in February 2026, the investigation established that the failure occurs in very specific operating conditions. After collecting more info through the spring and the summer, American Honda Motor ultimately determined that said issue constitutes a defect related to motor vehicle safety. No fewer than 146 warranty claims have been filed thus far, and Honda is aware of an injury report as well. Said report and the warranty claims were filed in the period from May 22, 2022, through October 22, 2026. The fix, meanwhile, involves new code for the EPS control unit. Dealers are much obliged to install the new software package through the OBD-II port at no charge to affected customers. Owners and lessees will be notified in December, with Honda targeting December 14, 2026. The NHTSA's database contains all subject VINs as of this writing. Liked the article? records.title: A new-generation Honda CR-V mid-size SUV is in the works and will pivot to a hybrid-only model
records.excerpt: Honda’s future line-up plans have just been leaked, and there are some big models coming. A dealer source has revealed key details from a tell-all Honda meeting in the United States, according to AutoNews. The Japanese brand is planning to introduce a new-generation hybrid-only CR-V mid-size SUV and track-focused Type R variant, as well as a new Accord sedan, among other models. These moves are all part of Honda’s plans to further boost market share in the United States in the next five years. Honda will invest $3 billion US into its new assembly plant in Ohio as it pivots towards hybrid production. In the meeting, the brand revealed the first details of its seventh-generation CR-V that will arrive in the US in 2027. Honda will shift the CR-V to a hybrid-only line-up from 2027, mirroring the Toyota RAV4. The new hybrid system will employ two electric motors and provide boosted performance compared to the current generation (135kW/335Nm in Australia), while improving fuel efficiency by 10 per cent. It will also be the first Honda to offer an electric all-wheel drive system, using a dedicated rear-axle motor. The car will ride on a lighter and stiffer platform that’s designed to provide a sportier driving experience. Honda has sketched a bolder exterior design for the CR-V in line with other redesigns for rivals in the segment. The CR-V is currently available with petrol and hybrid choices in Australia, but this announcement means buyers can expect a hybrid-only approach moving forward. The current-generation Aussie-spec CR-V is built in Thailand, rather than Japan or the US. It’s unclear when the new CR-V will hit Australian showrooms, with Honda yet to confirm where it will source right-hand-drive examples from. The CR-V is Honda’s best-selling model in Australia, edging out the smaller HR-V and ZR-V SUVs. The dealer meeting confirmed a few other models that are due to launch in 2027 and beyond, starting with a new Honda Accord. The Accord sedan will launch in the second half of 2027, exclusive of a sporty SUV that wasn’t mentioned at the meeting, but rumoured for its next-generation coming in 2028 or 2029. It’s expected to feature more futuristic styling, including a sweeping hood and slim headlights to foreshadow the incoming CR-V. The meeting also briefly mentioned the Civic Type R, showing off a track-ready version painted in blue and developed by Honda's racing division, but there were no details on performance figures. The Ridgeline ute and Pilot large three-row SUV are also due for new generations before 2030. Those two models are mainly sold in North America, meaning they're only built in left-hand drive, at least for now. Honda Australia's CEO recently told CarsGuide, that the Australian division would be arguing the case for future large platform vehicles to be built in right-hand drive, thanks in no small part to the ongoing dealer and customer demand for the Ridgeline ute. This news follows Honda Australia teasing the Avancier hybrid three-row SUV in November 2026 as what looks likely to be the brand’s next introduction Down Under. While the brand hasn’t officially confirmed the Thai-built Avancier will launch in Australia, there's likely to be more information in the coming weeks.

So I think still this is a positive point. “He understands what is happening at trackside, so I think he will bring this experience to the Japan side and also boost our development. So I think everything is positive for us.” ## More on Aston Martin from PlanetF1.com [Adrian Newey compares Aston Martin trouble to Red Bull turmoil](https://www.planetf1.com/news/adrian-newey-compares-aston-martin-red-bull) [Adrian Newey weighs in on ‘two-tier’ F1 debate](https://www.planetf1.com/news/adrian-newey-two-tier-f1-debate) Aston Martin chief trackside officer Mike Krack spoke from the team’s side regarding Mibe-san’s presence at the Brazilian Grand Prix. “I think it was good. It’s always good. So it’s nice to have Honda execs with us. “I was not part of the meetings because I have another job. But I’m sure that there were good conversations, and we welcome any kind of Honda exec any time to be with us here. It is good that they come to see how the action is like. “I hope that going forward they will go home with a smile.” Aston Martin sits 10th in the F1 2026 Constructors’ Championship standings with just three rounds remaining. Williams is one position and five points up the road. All seven of Aston Martin’s points have been scored through Fernando Alonso, via a P10 in Monaco, P9 at Zandvoort and 8th in Malaysia. **Read next: [Kimi Antonelli to Ferrari? records.title: Next-gen Honda CR-V to go hybrid-only; Will be launched only in the US with a new platform
records.excerpt: Honda’s seventh-generation CR-V will arrive in 2027 with a new hybrid system, electric all-wheel drive and a new modular platform. Honda will make the next-generation CR-V a hybrid-only model in the US, dropping the current petrol-only version. The seventh-generation 2028 SUV is due in 2027 with a two-motor hybrid system and an all-new platform. It arrives as the nameplate turns 30.The SUV will debut the fifth generation of Honda’s two-motor hybrid technology. Revisions will let the engine operate more often within its most efficient range and improve the hybrid unit’s driving efficiency. Honda is targeting a fuel-efficiency gain of more than 10 per cent, but has not disclosed the new system’s specifications.New AWD drivetrain A new electric all-wheel-drive system will offer more precise motor control. The current US model has a 1.5-litre turbo-petrol engine producing 190 hp and 243 Nm, paired with a CVT, or a 2.0-litre hybrid powertrain with a combined 204 hp and an e-CVT. The petrol option will be dropped.Hybrids drive Honda’s US strategyThe decision reflects rising hybrid demand. Annual sales of the CR-V hybrid have grown nearly tenfold since its 2020 launch. Hybrids account for around 30 per cent of Honda brand sales. Honda set hybrid sales records in 2024 and 2025 and expects another in 2026.The CR-V is the US’s all-time bestselling SUV, with more than 7.5 million sold, and has been Honda’s top-selling vehicle every year since 2017. It is expected to exceed 400,000 sales for a third consecutive year and was the US best-selling light-duty vehicle through October 2026. Honda plans more hybrid launches in North America by 2030.New platform and US productionThe modular platform is designed to lower weight while maintaining high body rigidity. It will allow greater parts sharing across models, with Honda targeting better vehicle control, safety and driving response.The new hybrid power unit will be built at Honda’s Ohio transmission plant using domestic and globally sourced parts. The Anna Engine Plant will manufacture the four-cylinder Atkinson-cycle engine. Honda plans to increase hybrid-system production capacity at the Ohio facility by 250 per cent. The CR-V will continue to be made at the East Liberty Auto Plant in Ohio, the Indiana Auto Plant and Honda of Canada Mfg. Since 2006, more than seven million CR-Vs have been produced in North America, roughly half in the US."With a 100 per cent hybrid powertrain, the next-generation Honda CR-V will further expand the appeal of America's most popular SUV as demand for hybrid-electric vehicles reaches record levels," said Luis Guerra, assistant vice president of Honda National Auto Sales.

records.excerpt: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援 – 日刊自動車新聞 2026.11.15(日) 管理者 紙面で読む 会社案内 各種申し込み 購読のご案内 ログイン 購読の ご案内 管理者 紙面で 読む ログイン 検索 トップ 自動車流通 開発・生産 行政・輸送 Home 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー , 自動車メーカー , 人事・組織改正 2026年5月29日 11:30 SNSで共有: 井上勝史氏 ホンダと日立が出資する自動車部品メーカーのアステモ（東京都千代田区）は5月29日、ホンダの井上勝史取締役が7月1日付で社長CEO（最高経営責任者）に就任するトップ人事を内定したと発表した。竹内弘平社長CEOは退任する。6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。1963年10月22日生まれ、62歳。福岡県出身。 〈2026/5/29更新〉 SNSで共有: 関連記事 ホンダ、現実路線で四輪事業の収益改善へ 開発費・期間・工数を半減 「開発スピードは世界トップレベルに」 2026年5月15日 05:00 ｜ 自動車メーカー , 企画・解説・オピニオン ホンダ、電動化戦略を見直し EV目標は撤回 2029年度までに次世代HV15モデル投入 新型セダンとアキュラSUVも公開 2026年5月14日 14:10 ｜ 自動車メーカー ホンダ、アステモを子会社化 ソフトやAI開発加速 新規株式公開も視野 2025年12月18日 05:00 ｜ 自動車メーカー , 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー ホンダ系サプライヤー、EV戦略見直しに「補償求める」「量産前の決断歓迎」などの声 2026年3月13日 05:00 ｜ 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー 資本再編進む自動車サプライヤー 親子上場の解消 円安で外資も意欲 経営資源集中でEVやSDVに対応 2026年1月1日 05:00 ｜ 企画・解説・オピニオン , 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー サーヴェンティスが2026～27年のカラートレンド予測、アジア太平洋は銀系の「ホライゾンフラックス」 2026年11月14日 05:00 ｜ 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー アクセスランキング 直近 昨日 一週間 ワンソクTubeのブログはこちら 【レクサス大丈夫か?!】2026年上半期の新車販売台数ランキングTOP50で異変! 意外な車が上位へ?! レクサスを叱咤激励するオーナーたちの意外な本音とは?! records.title: 本田半年净利增长65.7％，全球利润靠关税、汇率、摩托车业务，在华关厂止损
records.excerpt: 本田半年净利增长65.7％，全球利润靠关税、汇率、摩托车业务，在华关厂止损 新浪财经 来源：华夏时报 本报（chinatimes.net.cn）记者刘凯 北京报道 近日，本田汽车发布2027财年上半年（4—9月）财报。报告期内营收12.04万亿日元，同比增长13.2%；归母净利润5167.61亿日元，同比大增65.7%，半年已超出公司此前给出的全年4000亿日元预期；营业利润6487亿日元，同比增长48.1%，而本田8月上调后的全年营业利润目标为6500亿日元，半年接近完成全年目标。 同一周，本田中国公布10月终端销量28652辆，同比下滑52.2%，连续32个月同比下滑。广汽本田广州黄埔工厂今年6月已停产，东风本田武汉工厂计划2027年关停，在华燃油车产能从约120万辆压缩到72万辆。 汽车业务仍在失血 本田这轮业绩翻身，最直接的推手来自外部环境松动。上一财年，美国对进口汽车加征的高额关税让本田损失惨重，公司曾估算单财年关税损失约4500亿日元。随着美国将对日汽车关税从27.5%下调至15%，本田预计本财年关税因素将同比带来约1470亿日元的增利效果。汇率是第二个增长引擎，上半财年本田平均结算汇率为159日元兑1美元，上年同期为145日元。今年8月，本田已将全年汇率假设从145日元上调至155日元，当时估算仅汇率一项就可为全年营业利润增厚约1700亿日元。日元贬值让海外利润换回更多日元，账面利润随之抬升。 展开剩余 72 % 外部红利推高整体利润的同时，本田内部业务板块的盈利分化也愈发显著。上半财年本田摩托车全球销量1190万辆，同比增长10.6%，创同期历史新高，印度和巴西市场贡献主要增量。营收2.27万亿日元，营业利润4390亿日元，利润率19.3%。摩托车只贡献18.9%的营收，却拿走67.7%的营业利润，利润结构明显倾斜。第一财季摩托车营业利润2339亿日元，利润率20.5%，远超汽车板块。汽车业务上半财年全球销量156.9万辆，同比下滑6.6%，中国市场减少15.2万辆是最大拖累；北美市场增至89.7万辆，同比增长4.1万辆，紧凑型车、节能车和混动车型需求旺盛。 汽车行业观察员赵永琪在接受《华夏时报》记者采访时表示，关税下调和日元贬值属于外部条件改善，摩托车则是长期积累的稳定利润源，三者共同把账面利润推高，但汽车主业的盈利能力并没有同步修复。电动车业务半年亏损4848亿日元，说明转型成本仍在消化，混动带来的现金流可以争取时间，却难以替代纯电和智能化领域的长期投入。利润表好看，并不意味汽车业务已经走出调整期。 值得一提的是，受叫停北美3款纯电车型等电动化战略调整影响，本田上一财年计提约1.58万亿日元巨额损失，录得1957年上市以来首次年度净亏损，亏损额4239亿日元。本财年电动车相关损失基本出清，第一财季已不再计提，基数效应放大了本期利润增幅。 但拆分季度看，二季度（7—9月）营业利润回落至884亿日元，净利润仅659亿日元，环比骤减超85%，电动化重组费用仍在拖累毛利率。上半年整体毛利率18.44%，同比减少1.77个百分点。 中国市场变成止损对象 从销量数据来看，本田在中国市场的下滑已持续五年。10月终端销量28652辆，同比下降52.2%；1—10月累计31.18万辆，同比下降40.9%。主力车型集体失速，思域、雅阁月销均跌破万辆，10月唯一确认月销过万的只有东风本田CR-V，销量10455辆，纯电产品更加惨淡。本田在华巅峰是2020年的162.7万辆，广汽本田80.66万辆、东风本田82.04万辆同步刷新历史峰值。此后一路走低，2021年156.15万辆、2022年137.31万辆、2023年123.42万辆、2024年85.23万辆、2025年64.53万辆。 持续走弱的销量背后，并非产品硬件本身存在硬伤，而是市场环境与开发机制的双重掣肘。 本田量产车与同类型、同级别车型相比并不落下风，真正的变量是纯燃油车市场占有率整体萎缩，而本田产品升级迭代节奏偏慢，未跟上中国市场变化速度。国内新能源车企普遍能做到18—24个月的产品开发周期，快速跟进座舱、智驾、续航等用户需求。 本田由日本总部定义车型、合资公司负责导入的模式，在自主品牌以月为单位迭代、本土供应链定义成本的竞争中显得滞后。战略层面，本田已将中国移出“重点强化国”名单，资源全面转向美国、日本、印度三大核心市场。中国市场从利润中心变成止损对象，这一转身本质上是承认旧模式在华失效。 赵永琪对《华夏时报》记者分析，本田在华压缩产能，是面对销量长期下滑的被动出清。赵永琪认为，2027年的新车能否真正贴合中国用户对智能座舱、辅助驾驶和成本控制的要求，取决于本田愿意把多少底层开发权限交给中国团队，也取决于合资伙伴在本土供应链中的协同深度。如果只是把全球车型做一次更彻底的本地化适配，翻盘概率有限；如果能把中国作为独立产品定义中心，本田至少还有留在牌桌上的机会。 面对持续承压的中国市场，本田也推出了对应的战略改革，试图破解旧体系弊病。此前，本田在华发布新战略，核心是把中国从重要销售市场升级为“技术研发与产品决策的发生地”。过去模式是“全球车型在日本完成定义，再导入中国做本地化适配”，中国团队扮演执行者。新战略明确，中国消费者需要什么样的技术，需要在中国现地判断、现地决策，并据此推进研发。研发决策权从总部前移到中国团队，日系从“技术输出方”转为“技术输入方”。 未来两年，本田计划向中国市场投放11款车型，执行“新能源全面加速、燃油车稳中求进”双轨，燃油车一端扩充搭载新一代混合动力系统的车型阵容；新能源一端从2027年起，同时推进中方合作伙伴平台与本田自主开发两条路线。 在赵永琪看来，这批2027年落地的新车，大概率是本田在华关键窗口期。若新品能踩中中国用户需求，补齐智能化短板，销量和产能利用率尚有回升空间；若表现不及预期，持续的产能闲置和份额流失，或将带来进一步资产减值压力，边缘化风险上升。本田不是第一个在中国市场收缩的日系品牌，也不会是最后一个。 责任编辑：李延安 主编：于建平

records.excerpt: 日本4大车厂在陆产量年减32%！创18年新低，本田跌近9成_车家号_发现车生活_汽车之家 选择城市 更多 移动App 触屏版 小程序 i车商 本地服务 登录 发布作品 下载App 扫码下载汽车之家App 小程序 扫码打开汽车之家小程序 点赞 评论 收藏 分享 当前位置： 日本4大车厂在陆产量年减32%！创18年新低，本田跌近9成 图波夫车车 车家号 · 0 浏览 · 2026-11-08 16:47 · 海南 日本 4大车厂今年4月至9月在 中国 的生产量较去年同期大减32%，降至约102万辆，创18年来新低，与2020年高峰期相比更萎缩63%。其中， 本田 产量较高峰期暴跌近9成，反映中国燃油车市场快速萎缩，以及日本车厂在电动车竞争中陷入苦战。 日本经济新闻报道，根据 丰田 、本田、 日产 及马自达等4家日本车厂29日公布的数据，今年4月至9月在中国的合计生产量为102万579辆，较去年同期大减32%，创2008年以来最低水准。相较2020年高峰期约280万辆，短短6年间减少近180万辆。 其中，本田减幅最为 显着 ，今年4月至9月在中国生产13万1716辆，年减60%，较2020年高峰期更减少近9成。日产同期生产16万3192辆，年减49%，较高峰期减少8成；丰田生产66万3079辆，年减18%；马自达虽较去年同期成长43%，但与2020年相比仍减少52%。 日系车厂产量急减，主要受到中国燃油车市场快速萎缩冲击。今年1月至9月，中国整体新车市场销量年减22%，除了经济低迷及新能源车购车补助缩减，中东局势紧张推升国际油价，也加速消费者转向电动车。 数据显示，今年前9个月，中国扣除新能源车的新车销量较去年同期减少超过3成，与2020年同期相比更萎缩6成。由于日本车厂在中国仍以燃油车及油电混合动力车为销售主力，因此受到市场结构转变的冲击尤其明显。 销售方面，本田今年4月至9月在中国销量年减48%，降至16万1372辆；日产则因主力燃油车款「轩逸」销售不振，整体销量年减46%，降至18万2854辆。 另一方面，日本车厂在中国电动车市场也未能取得竞争优势。本田同期电动车销量年减62%，仅2991辆，原订2025年底前上市的旗舰电动车「GT」，因销售环境恶化而无限期延后推出。 中国 汽车 市场自2020年起加速转向新能源车，比亚迪等本土品牌迅速崛起，使过去在中国市场占有重要地位的日本车厂市占率持续下滑，生产规模也退回大规模扩产前的水准。 日本车厂在中国的困境也波及零件供应商。日本汽车照明设备大厂小糸制作所20日宣布，将解散并清算中国的汽车灯具制造子公司，反映日本汽车产业供应链正加速调整中国业务。 美国调查公司Mobility Global预测，日本4大车厂2030年在中国的生产量将较2025年减少47%，降至约160万辆。 不过，中国仍是日本车厂难以放弃的重要市场。2025年，中国市场占丰田全球销量17%、本田18%、日产21%；对3家车厂而言，均是仅次于美国的第2大市场。 报道说，面对中国市场竞争加剧，日本车厂正寻求调整经营策略，包括提高生产效率、强化电动化技术，以及将中国转型为出口基地。 丰田8日宣布与广州汽车集团以及中国第一汽车集团签署新战略合作协议，将重整在中国的合资企业，加速推动汽车电动化及智能化；日产则已开始从中国向墨西哥出口汽车，马自达也将中国生产的电动车销往欧洲及澳洲等市场。 然而，中国车厂同样积极布局海外市场，日本车厂即使转向出口，也难以避开与中国品牌的激烈竞争。 精华 FAQQ1：日本4大车厂今年4月至9月在中国的产量为何大幅下滑？ 合计生产量仅102万579辆，较去年同期大减32%，并创2008年以来新低。主因是中国燃油车市场快速萎缩，消费者转向新能源车，日系车又仍以燃油车与油电混合车为主。 Q2：哪一家日本车厂在中国受到的冲击最严重，跌幅有多大？ 本田受创最深，今年4月至9月在中国生产13万1716辆，年减60%，较2020年高峰期更暴跌近9成。其销量也年减48%，电动车销量仅2991辆，反映转型压力很大。 Q3：面对中国市场变化，日本车厂目前采取了哪些调整措施？ 日本车厂正提高生产效率、强化电动化技术，并把中国部分产能转为出口基地。丰田重整合资企业，日产已从中国出口到墨西哥，马自达也将中国生产的电动车销往欧洲与澳洲。 本内容来自汽车之家创作者，不代表汽车之家的观点和立场。 文章标签 点赞 评论 收藏 分享 举报/纠错 本文作者 图波夫车车 3160 关注 · 7863 作品 关注 新车视频讯息，摩托车讯息，国外改装汽车，高清汽车视频！ 作者其他作品 进入主页 斯巴鲁新Sambar Truck登场！尺寸对标N-BOX，换三缸引擎 ！ 46分钟前 雷克萨斯新LS?! records.title: 2026年Q1，广汽本田在中国卖了仅 4.01万辆
records.excerpt: 2026年Q1，广汽本田在中国卖了仅 4.01万辆_车家号_发现车生活_汽车之家 选择城市 更多 移动App 触屏版 小程序 i车商 本地服务 登录 发布作品 下载App 扫码下载汽车之家App 小程序 扫码打开汽车之家小程序 点赞 评论 收藏 分享 当前位置： 2026年Q1，广汽本田在中国卖了仅 4.01万辆 丑小鸭说车 车家号 · 0 浏览 · 2026-04-24 16:25 · 海南 这就是赤裸裸的现实！ 2020年，广汽本田在中国卖了约 81万辆； 2021年，广汽本田在中国卖了78.03万辆； 2022年，广汽本田在中国卖了74.18万辆； 2023年，广汽本田在中国卖了64.05万辆； 2024年，广汽本田在中国卖了47.06万辆； 2025年，广汽本田在中国卖了35.19万辆； 2026年Q1，广汽本田在中国卖了仅 4.01万辆。 从2020年峰值的81万，再到2025年的35.19万辆，连续5年暴跌，到了2026年第一季度，不仅没有止跌企稳，销量反而下滑更厉害，第一季度仅卖了4.01万辆，销量萎缩，断崖式的下滑，使得广本从主流合资跌至边缘。 目前，广汽本田几乎全靠 雅阁 ( 参数 | 询价 )、皓影这两款车续命，雅阁2025年销量15.21万辆，占总销量约43%，皓影2025年销量12.01万辆，占总销量约34%。 其余车型全面崩盘，连飞度都不行了，2025年有个月销量曾低至16台，缤智、冠道、奥德赛等即使价格再降，年销也都不到1万。 这是啥概念？昔日的抢手货，现在无人问津。与时俱进，才能跟上时代的步伐，广汽本田长期吃雅阁、飞度老本，10年不换代，电动化转型极慢，2024年才建新能源工厂，纯电车型毫无竞争力，纯电P7月销仅百余辆。 智能化配置全面落后，原来的燃油车可靠、省油的优势，也被比亚迪DM-i抹平，优势不再。长期下去，广汽本田只会越来越边缘化。 本内容来自汽车之家创作者，不代表汽车之家的观点和立场。 文章标签 车系标签 点赞 评论 收藏 分享 举报/纠错 文中提及 雅阁 17.98-21.48万 4.32 本文作者 丑小鸭说车 2.7万 关注 · 7355 作品 关注 专注汽车资讯 作者其他作品 进入主页 大汉上市，比亚迪的打法变了！ 10-22 再不努力，以后只能开奔驰S级、奥迪A8、宝马X7了 10-22 留给日本汽车产业的时间不多了 10-22 续航超过1000公里的纯电车，比亚迪无敌是多么寂寞 10-21 热门内容 今日 本周 换一换 05:04 开埃安Ray7去让古村，用驾驶辅助跑完全程是什么体验？ 昨天 20:49 03:03 限时置换加量不加价 探店2027 款途观 L Pro 昨天 21:32 04:58 曾是顶流德系瓦罐！优惠68折，奥迪A6 Allroad如今40万内可入手！ 9小时前 02:05 惊喜满满，抢拍日产NX7 昨天 22:17 精彩视频 换一换 14:54 全网最狠B级车大横评 谁夯谁拉？ 汽车天涯 15:35 200kg满载+连续16拐！复刻WRC拉力赛，8台主流B级车实力大考 汽车天涯 12:44 悬崖峭壁 南太行 WRC 四国 B 级车巅峰厮杀 谁是王者？ 汽车天涯 12:22 老黄历翻篇！曾经不会买错的三台日系B级车，现在还香吗？ 赵璞工作室 热门文章标签 评测体验 海选导购 新车资讯 用车攻略 二手车 改装车 自驾旅行 越野 文化历史 技术解析 车展 扫码下载汽车之家App © 2026 汽车之家 www.autohome.com.cn 京公网安备 11010802000104号 京ICP备09113703号-1 信息网络传播视听节目许可证: 0110553 广播电视节目制作经营许可证 公司名称：北京车之家信息技术有限公司 中央网信办违法和不良信息举报中心 违法和不良信息举报电话：400-868-5856 举报邮箱：jubao@autohome.com.cn 隐私协议 营业执照 2026/11/15 17:46:17

records.title: FIA announces date when Tsunoda could lose a championship point
records.excerpt: The FIA will hear Audi’s appeal over the decision not to penalize Yuki Tsunoda on November 25; he could lose the championship point he scored at Monza. Yuki Tsunoda could still lose his World Championship point more than two months after the Italian Grand Prix. The FIA has announced when Audi’s appeal against the stewards’ de FIA sets date for hearing that could cost Tsunoda a championship point F1 News 12:30, 13 Nov 0 Comments Shanna Lutgert Shanna is a Formula 1 journalist at GPblog, specializing in both F1 and endurance and GT racing. With a Master’s degree in Journalism and experience at international circuits, she provides in-depth, reliable coverage and insights based on her presence at Grands Prix and racing events worldwide. Yuki Tsunoda could still lose his World Championship point more than two months after the Italian Grand Prix. The FIA has announced when Audi’s appeal against the stewards’ decision will be heard. The German team believes the Racing Bulls driver wrongly escaped a penalty during the race at Monza. The FIA has scheduled the hearing for Wednesday, 25 November at 09:00 in Paris. The appeal will be heard by the International Court of Appeal behind closed doors. The international motorsport federation expects to announce its decision as soon as possible after the hearing. Why Audi appealed Tsunoda’s penalty The case concerns an incident during the Italian Grand Prix on 6 September. After a red flag, the field had to line up again for the restart. Tsunoda initially headed towards the wrong grid slot, but corrected himself and put his Racing Bulls in the right position. However, his car was positioned at an angle. Race director Rui Marques decided to run an extra formation lap because of the situation. Under Article B5.9.4 of the sporting regulations, a driver who causes an extra formation lap must then start from the pit lane. If they do not, the regulations prescribe a stop-and-go penalty. ADVERTISEMENT Tsunoda nevertheless remained on the grid and was not penalised after the race. The stewards ruled that the Japanese driver was correctly positioned within his grid slot and that the extra formation lap had resulted from a decision by the race director. They also noted that Racing Bulls had not been informed that Tsunoda was being held responsible for the extra lap. The stewards therefore decided to take no further action. Audi disagreed with that explanation. The team announced after the race that it intended to appeal and formally lodged an appeal on 9 September. Audi argues that Tsunoda did cause the extra formation lap and should therefore have started from the pit lane. Since he did not, the team believes the mandatory penalty should have been imposed. Tsunoda could still lose his World Championship point The outcome could affect the final classification of the Italian Grand Prix. Tsunoda finished tenth, earning his first World Championship point of the season. Audi driver Gabriel Bortoleto crossed the finish line in eleventh place, just outside the points. If Audi’s appeal is successful and Tsunoda is given a time penalty, Bortoleto could move up to tenth. A stop-and-go penalty that is not served during the race is converted into a 30-second time penalty after the race. That would cost Tsunoda his tenth-place finish. ADVERTISEMENT The FIA must now decide whether the stewards correctly applied the regulations in September. The parties involved will have the opportunity to present their arguments at the hearing on 25 November. records.title: Imola reveals future F1 return plan after FIA announcement
records.excerpt: Imola has not hosted an F1 race since being removed from the calendar after its previous contract expired at the end of 2025. Imola reveals future F1 return plan after FIA announcement Taylor Powling 14 Nov 2026 10:46 AM Imola dropped off the F1 calendar after 2025 The Mayor of Imola has revealed that he is working on bringing Formula 1 back to the city, after being notified that the circuit will not be required to host a race in 2026. Imola had been placed on standby as a contingency option to end the 2026 season in case the races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi couldn’t go ahead amid the ongoing conflict in the Middle East. The Bahrain and Saudi Arabian Grands Prix, due to be held in April, were both cancelled, although the former was later rescheduled and hosted in Malaysia. Imola working on potential F1 return However, the FIA announced earlier this week that it is proceeding with plans to have the final two races of the ongoing campaign take place in Qatar and Abu Dhabi. In the circumstance where the events cannot be held, a replacement venue will not be sought, with next weekend’s Las Vegas Grand Prix to be treated as the season finale instead. But while Imola’s services will not be called upon this year, the city’s Mayor, Marco Panieri, divulged that there is a desire to see F1 race at the Italian venue in the future. “We note the intention, as reported in the media, to confirm the final Grand Prix races of the season in Qatar and Abu Dhabi, in light of developments on the international stage,” Panieri posted on Instagram. “We would have loved to experience this historic moment alongside the newly crowned world champion Kimi Antonelli, the teams and our extraordinary fans. A shared dream that today becomes a source of renewed energy for the future. “Our journey to bring the ‘Made in Italy’ and Emilia-Romagna Grand Prix back to Imola continues. Together with President Michele de Pascale, the Emilia-Romagna Region, ACI and our institutional and sporting partners, we will continue to work to promote our Motor Valley and reaffirm Imola’s readiness to host Formula 1. “With the pride and determination of our region, we look to the future. We are convinced that the best is yet to come.” More from PlanetF1.com ‘How wrong I was’ – How Michael Schumacher took Mercedes insider by surprise ‘Obscene’ Adrian Newey salary demand in Christian Horner book claim The Autodromo Enzo e Dino Ferrari, better known as Imola, was a permanent fixture on the F1 calendar from 1981 to 2006, during which time it ran under the title of the San Marino Grand Prix due to Monza’s presence as the host of the Italian Grand Prix. Following a protracted absence, Imola was drafted in to hold its first race in 16 years in 2020 after the COVID-19 pandemic forced several rounds to be cancelled. Despite having been intended to be an isolated event, F1 returned five months later as Imola took the place of the Chinese Grand Prix as the second round on the 2021 schedule. That precipitated a permanent inclusion on the calendar from 2022, though the race was cancelled in 2023 due to extreme flooding throughout the Emilia-Romagna region. And although it was granted an additional one-year extension to its deal to cover that abandonment, Imola hasn’t featured since its previous contract expired after 2025. It remains to be seen if Imola is seeking to hold a yearly spot on the calendar, or whether it could become a rotational option, like Spa-Francorchamps and Barcelona.
