records.title: アメリカの物価高が止まらない！ インフレ率4％に加速、FRBが「大幅利上げ」に踏み切る可能性（ニューズウィーク日本版）
records.excerpt: アメリカの物価高が止まらない！ インフレ率4％に加速、FRBが「大幅利上げ」に踏み切る可能性 11/13(金) 7:00 配信 FRB内からも大幅利上げを求める声が浮上している FRB blvdone-shutterstock アメリカで物価上昇の勢いが再び強まっている。AP通信によると、10月の消費者物価上昇率は前年同月比で約4％に達したと推計され、9月の3.7％から加速した可能性がある。 【動画】追加利上げを支持する理由を説明するFRBのウォラー理事 11月10日に発表された消費者物価指数（CPI）は前月比0.4％上昇し、市場予想を上回った。食品やエネルギーだけでなく、家電製品や保険料、各種サービスなど幅広い分野に値上がりが広がっており、インフレの長期化に対する警戒感が強まっている。 今回の発表で特に注目されたのは、変動の激しい食品とエネルギーを除いた「コアCPI」だ。 米労働統計局によると、10月のコアCPIは前月比0.3％上昇し、8月から3カ月連続で同じ伸び率となった。市場では0.2％への鈍化が予想されていたが、実際にはインフレ圧力が根強く残っていることを示した。 アメリカの中央銀行に当たる連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）は、個人消費支出（PCE）物価指数の上昇率について、長期的に2％を目標としている。 しかし、足元のインフレは依然として高い水準にある。 こうした状況が長引けば、FRBは景気への悪影響を覚悟してでも、通常より大幅な利上げに踏み切ることになるのだろうか？ 関税とエネルギー高、広がる物価上昇 物価高の背景には、複数の要因が絡み合っている。 ロイター通信によると、トランプ政権が導入した輸入関税に加え、中東情勢の緊迫化による原油価格の上昇が生活費を押し上げている。関税によって輸入品の調達費用が増えれば、その負担の一部は販売価格に転嫁される。 エネルギー価格の上昇は輸送費や製造コストにも波及する。実際に10月の食品価格は前月比0.5％、エネルギー価格は0.7％上昇した。家庭向け食料品は0.4％、外食は0.5％上昇しており、日々の買い物や食事にかかる費用が増えている。 食品や燃料など生活に欠かせない商品の値上がりは、低所得層の家計に大きな影響を及ぼす可能性がある。 物価上昇はガソリンや食品だけにとどまらない。AP通信によると、自動車保険や動画配信サービス、牛肉などの価格が上昇したほか、スマートフォンやコンピューターなども値上がりしている。 人工知能（AI）関連の投資拡大も、新たなインフレ要因として注目されている。データセンターの建設や半導体需要の増加によって、電子機器や電力に対する需要が強まっているためだ。 米労働統計局によると、10月の住居費は前月比0.3％上昇し、総合CPIの上昇分の3割以上を占めた。医療サービスや教育、娯楽関連の価格も上昇しており、物価高が生活のさまざまな分野に波及していることが明らかになっている。 次ページは：FRB内部で強まる大幅利上げ論 前へ 1 2 3 次へ 1 / 3ページ 【関連リンク】 【動画】追加利上げを支持する理由を説明するFRBのウォラー理事 トランプのアメリカはどこへ向かう 米軍を弱体化させ、共和党を敗北させた「責任者」ヘグセス国防長官…それでもクビにならない理由 米中間選挙でAI推進派議員が相次ぎ落選…共和党大敗を招いたのは「データセンターへの怒り」？ トランプ関税に「終わりの始まり」か…中間選挙で圧勝した民主党が狙う大統領権限の奪還

records.title: 【来週の注目材料】米小売売上高はやや伸びが鈍化も、堅調な消費動向示すか
records.excerpt: 【来週の注目材料】米小売売上高はやや伸びが鈍化も、堅調な消費動向示すか 為替 2026/11/14(土) 17:10 17日に10月の米小売売上高が発表されます。米個人消費の動向を示す指標として注目されています。 前回9月の小売売上高は前月比+0.8％と市場予想の+0.3％を大きく上回りました。8月分も速報時の+1.2％から+1.3％に上方修正されています。 9月の小売売上高の内訳をみると、ガソリンスタンド売上が前月比+6.4％となり全体を押し上げています。米エネルギー情報局（EIA）による全米全種平均のガソリン価格推移をみると、8月の1ガロン当たり4.192ドルから9月は同4.491ドルまで7.1％の上昇となっています。米国ではほとんどの場所でガソリンが生活必需品となっているだけに、価格が上がっても販売量はそれほど下がらない（価格弾力性が低い）ため、ガソリン価格の上昇が小売売上高に大きく反映された形です。その他、フードサービスが+1.1％と好調さを維持。家具（+1.3％）、家電（+0.6％）、ヘルスケア（+0.7％）などもしっかり伸びています。8月が+2.0％と強かった反動で落ち込みが見込まれていた無店舗小売（アマゾンなどのインターネットショッピング）は+0.3％と伸びが鈍化もプラス圏を維持。建材・園芸が-0.6％、スポーツ・娯楽が-0.5％と冴えない結果になりました。ガソリンを除くとまちまちという印象が強くなっています。 今回の10月小売売上高は前月比+0.2％と伸びが一気に鈍化する見込みとなっています。9月から10月にかけてガソリンの小売価格が落ち着いており、EIAの全米全種平均では前月比-0.9％となっています。そのため前回から伸びが鈍化するという見通しとなりました。 もっとも、個人消費動向にかなり強い影響を与える雇用状況は、6日に発表された10月の米雇用統計での非農業部門雇用者数の高い伸びをみる限り非常に好調です。また、米GDPの個人消費算出に利用される小売売上高のコントロールグループ（自動車・同部品、ガソリンスタンド、建材・園芸用品、飲食店を除いた小売売上高）の予想は+0.4％と9月の+0.1％から伸びると見込まれており、予想前後であれば、12月の利上げを阻むような数字にはなりません。前回のように予想を超えて伸びた場合には、12月の利上げの後、1月にも追加利上げを行い、さらに3月にはもう一段の利上げを行うとの見方が広がり、ドル高になる可能性があります。 MINKABUPRESS 山岡 執筆者 : MINKABU PRESS 資産形成情報メディア「みんかぶ」や、投資家向け情報メディア「株探」を中心に、マーケット情報や株・FXなどの金融商品の記事の執筆を行う編集部です。 投資に役立つニュースやコラム、投資初心者向けコンテンツなど幅広く提供しています。 関連タグ #米雇用統計 関連通貨ペア 米ドル/円 ユーロ/円 英ポンド/円 ユーロ/米ドル ユーロ/豪ドル ポンド/米ドル ユーロ/ポンド 英ポンド/豪ドル 英ポンド/スイス 英ポンド/NZドル 米ドル/カナダ 米ドル/スイス

records.title: 【これからの見通し】ドルが一段と上昇するか、米ＰＰＩに注目、ドル円は一時１６０円台の危険水域に
records.excerpt: 【これからの見通し】ドルが一段と上昇するか、米ＰＰＩに注目、ドル円は一時１６０円台の危険水域に 為替 2026/11/13(金) 15:59 【これからの見通し】ドルが一段と上昇するか、米ＰＰＩに注目、ドル円は一時１６０円台の危険水域に 今週はドル高の流れが強まっている。12月米FOMCを視野に入れ、米金融当局者のタカ派発言や米CPI前月比の上振れなどが利上げ観測を高めたことが背景。本日はインフレデータとして米PPI発表が控えている。米CPIでは発表されなかった「前年比」のデータも発表される予定。一段とドル買いをサポートする材料となるのか、市場の注目度が高まりやすい状況だ。 今回発表される10月米PPIの予想は、前年比が+6.6％（前回+6.3％）、コア前年比が+5.0％（前回+5.0％）と根強いインフレ圧力が示される内容となっている。一方で、前月比は+0.4％（前回+1.3％）、コア前月比は+0.3％（前回+0.7％）と伸びが鈍化する見込みとなっている。発表時刻は日本時間午後10時30分の予定。 そのなかで、ドル円は160円をめぐって神経質な値動きがみられている。日本時間午後3時過ぎに高値を160.19レベルまで伸ばしたあと、一気に159.60台まで急反落している。市場では日本時間午後3時の東京カット・オプション関連のフローの思惑や、政府・日銀による介入警戒感が高まっており、この後の海外市場でもボラタイルな値動きを想定しておきたい。 週末の相場はかなり緊張感を要する展開を覚悟しておきたい。 経済指標の発表予定は、前述の米PPIほぼ一択となる。その他には同時刻にカナダ製造業売上高（9月）、カナダ卸売売上高（9月）なども発表される。 発言イベント関連では、コリンズ・ボストン連銀総裁、ローガン・ダラス連銀総裁、ボウマンFRB副議長、デイリー・サンフランシスコ連銀総裁など一連の米金融当局者の発言機会が相次ぐ。米PPI結果を合わせてドル相場動向にとっての注目材料となりそうだ。 minkabu PRESS編集部 松木秀明 執筆者 : MINKABU PRESS 資産形成情報メディア「みんかぶ」や、投資家向け情報メディア「株探」を中心に、マーケット情報や株・FXなどの金融商品の記事の執筆を行う編集部です。 投資に役立つニュースやコラム、投資初心者向けコンテンツなど幅広く提供しています。 関連タグ #FOMC #日銀 関連通貨ペア 米ドル/円 ユーロ/円 英ポンド/円 ユーロ/米ドル ユーロ/豪ドル ポンド/米ドル ユーロ/ポンド 英ポンド/豪ドル 英ポンド/スイス 英ポンド/NZドル 米ドル/カナダ 米ドル/スイス

records.excerpt: 米10月卸売物価6.5％上昇 伸び率3年11カ月ぶり水準 11/13(金) 23:05 配信 【ワシントン共同】米労働省が13日発表した10月の卸売物価指数は前年同月より6.5％上昇した。伸び率は3カ月連続で拡大し、2022年11月以来、3年11カ月ぶりの高水準。市場予想の6.6％は下回った。モノは10.2％、サービスは5.0％上がった。 物価動向は連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）の金融政策を議論する上での重要指標。物価が高止まりすれば、利上げペースが速まる可能性がある。 モノのうち食品は1.7％上昇、エネルギーは37.0％上昇した。変動が激しい食品とエネルギーを全体から除いたコア指数の上昇率は5.0％で市場予想並みだった。 卸売物価指数の前月比（季節調整済み）は0.3％上昇した。モノが0.5％上がり、サービスは0.2％上がった。コア指数は0.3％上昇した。 【関連リンク】 三越伊勢丹HDは過去最高益 9月中間 北海道内2社は減収 ◆「星野リゾート」の人気ホテルが営業終了 「最高だったのに」「閉館悲しすぎて泣く」SNSには惜しむ声 ◆タイムズカー不正アクセス、660万件の個人情報漏えい 対象者、漏えいした情報一覧 東京結ぶ夜行高速バス再開 19日から両備バスなど 【速報】江田島市長の土手三生氏が死去 入院中、1期目

records.title: 米国の9月生産者物価、コアPPIが0.3%に鈍化 ビットコインは小幅高
records.excerpt: Title: 米国の9月生産者物価、コアPPIが0.3%に鈍化 ビットコインは小幅高 URL Source: http://finance.biggo.jp/news/74d9da4a-1aad-43a9-92bb-8de46fe5b930 Final URL: https://finance.biggo.jp/news/74d9da4a-1aad-43a9-92bb-8de46fe5b930 Published Time: 2026-11-13T14:25:18.000Z Markdown Content: 2026-11-13 14:25 (GMT+0) ![Image 1: 米国の9月生産者物価、コアPPIが0.3%に鈍化 ビットコインは小幅高](https://img.biggo.com/RFoM4LbYeF1nMA14FG8x9ieCFq2Z2QoVngughlpnqe4/fit/1720/0/sm/0/aHR0cHM6Ly9pbWcuYmdvLm9uZS9uZXdzLWltYWdlL2FpX2dlbmVyYXRlZC8yMDI2LTExLzc0ZDlkYTRhLTFhYWQtNDNhOS05MmJiLThkZTQ2ZmU1YjkzMF8xNzk0NTgwMTE5X2RlZmF1bHQuanBn.webp) 米国の9月の生産者段階のインフレは鈍化し、コア生産者物価指数（PPI）は前月比0.3%上昇と市場予想のコンセンサスに一致し、前月の0.7%を大きく下回った。総合PPIも予想を下回り、リスク資産に小幅な追い風となった。 米労働統計局形式の発表によると、指標は以下の通りだった。 | 指標 | 実績 | 予想 | 前回 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | コアPPI（前月比） | 0.3% | 0.3% | 0.7% | | コアPPI（前年比） | 5.0% | 5.0% | 5.0% | | PPI（前月比） | 0.3% | 0.4% | 1.3% | | PPI（前年比） | 6.5% | 6.6% | 6.3% | 注：数値は9月分で、報道で引用されたデータセットによれば2026年11月13日に発表された。 報道で引用された市場データによると、ビットコインは発表直前に6.922万ドル（約1,100万円）近辺で取引され、発表直後に約0.4%上昇して6.99万ドル（約1,100万円）となった。値動きは小幅ながら方向性は示唆的で、この暗号資産はここ数カ月、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）の政策期待を映す流動性の高い代理指標として取引されており、インフレ指標が予想を下回れば上昇し、上振れれば下落する動きを見せている。 重要なのは生産者物価の前月比の減速だ。川上段階のインフレ鈍化が持続すれば、追加利上げの市場織り込み確率が低下し、ドルと米国債利回りを押し下げる可能性がある。利回りの低下は、利子を生まない資産を保有する機会費用を減らし、歴史的にデジタル資産を支えてきた環境だ。初動の上昇が維持されるかは、ドルと短期ゾーンの利回りがこの動きを裏付けるかどうかにかかっている。 前年比の数値は逆方向に働く。総合PPIの6.5%は2022年11月以来の高水準であり、コアPPIも前年比5.0%で横ばいとなり、月次が鈍化しても物価圧力が根強く残っていることを示唆する。The Kobeissi Letterは前年比6.5%について2022年後半以来の高水準だと指摘し、消費者物価指数、生産者物価指数、個人消費支出（PCE）指標の持続的な上昇がいずれも12月の利上げを示唆していると論じた。 こうした緊張関係が市場の反応を限定的なものにしている。1カ月の軟調な数値だけでは1年分の累積的な上昇を打ち消せず、前年比は予想を上回るどころか一致にとどまった。予想を上回った火曜日の消費者物価報告がすでに引き締め政策への期待を強めており、木曜日の生産者物価統計はその見方を覆すには至らなかった。 報道で引用された市場アナリストは、今回の発表をインフレ圧力が徐々に和らいでいる兆候と位置づけ、「FRBの刺激策撤回戦略を和らげる可能性があり、短期的にデジタル資産にとって好ましい環境を提供し得る」と述べた。このアナリストの氏名は報道では明らかにされていない。 暗号資産投資家にとっての要点は、マクロ経済指標の発表が依然として短期的な主要変動要因だということだ。ビットコインの反応関数は金利期待と密接に結びついており、次の触媒はFRBの当局者発言と12月の会合前の追加のインフレ指標となる。ドルと米国債利回りの持続的な低下は今回の動きに続伸の余地を与えるが、いずれかの反発は上値を抑える可能性が高い。 広範なデジタル資産市場はマクロの触媒に対してビットコインの動きに追随する傾向があるため、同じ計算が各トークンにも当てはまる。議論の焦点は現在、9月の軟調な月次生産者物価が真のディスインフレ傾向の始まりなのか、それとも底堅いインフレ全体像の中での1カ月の例外なのかに移っている。 設定すると、Google 検索のトップニュースで BigGo records.excerpt: Title: グールズビー米シカゴ連銀総裁「FRBは2%物価目標に復帰できず…AIデータセンターが物価を押し上げ」 URL Source: http://finance.biggo.jp/news/4d42f7f1-67a6-48c6-8344-c4ace1e5acd4 Final URL: https://finance.biggo.jp/news/4d42f7f1-67a6-48c6-8344-c4ace1e5acd4 Published Time: 2026-11-13T14:35:11.000Z Markdown Content: 2026-11-13 14:35 (GMT+0) ![Image 1: グールズビー米シカゴ連銀総裁「FRBは2%物価目標に復帰できず…AIデータセンターが物価を押し上げ」](https://img.biggo.com/8M_GDzfE8ejo_Azpdb96mLpvXLtMfHVGECxK7NSWqiY/fit/1720/0/sm/0/aHR0cHM6Ly9pbWcuYmdvLm9uZS9uZXdzLWltYWdlL2FpX2dlbmVyYXRlZC8yMDI2LTExLzRkNDJmN2YxLTY3YTYtNDhjNi04MzQ0LWM0YWNlMWU1YWNkNF8xNzk0NTgwODk1X2RlZmF1bHQuanBn.webp) 米シカゴ連邦準備銀行のオースタン・グールズビー総裁は、インフレが連邦準備制度（FRB）の2%目標に向けて順調に低下していないとの診断を示した。同総裁は13日（現地時間）、CNBCの「スクワーク・ボックス」インタビューで「我々が2%へ戻る経路にあるかと問われれば、私の感覚では現時点でそうではなく、この問題に対処しなければならない」と述べた。 グールズビー総裁は、物価上昇圧力がエネルギーや関税コストを超えてサービスや医療など他の部門に波及していると指摘した。特に人工知能（AI）インフラ構築競争に伴うデータセンター建設の拡大が強い需要を刺激し、物価を押し上げていると指摘した。同総裁はサービス物価と上昇する医療費が短期間で落ち着く可能性は大きくないとの見方を示した。 同総裁は、需要が過熱する状況ではインフレを一時的な現象とみなして看過できないと強調した。インフレが悪化しているとのデータが出た場合、FRBがより積極的な対応に踏み切る可能性があるとの趣旨もにじませた。今後発表される物価指標が、利上げペースを速める必要があるかどうかを左右する変数になる見通しだ。 労働市場については、賃金が物価圧力に遅行する指標である点から、解釈には慎重であるべきだと述べた。賃金の動きだけで物価への影響を断定するのは難しいとの趣旨だ。同総裁は、FRBが信頼性を維持するには「明確にすべきことが残っている」と付け加えた。 エネルギー部門の構造的制約にも言及した。国際原油価格が急速に下落しても精製能力の問題が残るため、ディーゼルと航空燃料の価格は高水準を維持する可能性があるとの見方だ。これはエネルギー由来の物価圧力を完全に解消するのは難しいことを示唆する。 今回の発言は、FRB内部でも物価鈍化のペースに対する警戒感が依然として強いことを示している。市場参加者は今後の物価指標とFRB委員の発言を通じて、金利経路の方向を見極めることになりそうだ。 設定すると、Google 検索のトップニュースで BigGo ファイナンスが優先的に表示され、最も幅広く・最も速く・最も網羅的なグローバル金融ニュースをいち早くチェックできます。 [優先する情報源に追加](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=finance.biggo.jp)

records.title: 米卸売物価、10月は前年比6.5%上昇―約4年ぶり高水準、12月利上げ圧力
records.excerpt: 米労働統計局（BLS）が13日発表した10月の生産者物価指数（PPI、最終需要）は前年同月比6.5%上昇し、2022年11月以来、約4年ぶりの高い伸びとなった。12月の米連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）を前に、インフレ長期化への懸念が強まっている。 ■前月比は0.3%上昇に鈍化 国内生産者の視点から価格動向を示すPPIは、10月に前月比0.3%上昇（季節調整済み）した。9月の1.4%、8月の0.4%から伸びが鈍化し、市場予想の0.4%も下回った。 季節調整前の前年同月比は6.5%上昇した。7.4%上昇した2022年11月以来の大きな伸びだが、市場予想の6.6%はわずかに下回った。 PPIは生産コストの上昇が消費者に転嫁されやすいことから、インフレの先行指標とされる。今回の結果は、FRBによる一段のインフレ抑制策を後押しする可能性がある。 ■財は0.5%上昇、サービスは5カ月連続の上昇 財価格は10月に0.5%上昇し、9月の2.5%上昇から伸びが縮小した。食品は1.3%上昇した一方、エネルギーは0.1%下落した。 財価格の上昇の6割超は、0.5%上昇した食品・エネルギーを除く財によるものだった。基礎有機化学品が3.9%上昇したほか、生鮮・乾燥野菜、ジェット燃料、加工若鶏肉なども値上がりした。 一方、BLSによると、ディーゼル燃料の価格は10月に7.9%下落した。 サービス価格は0.2%上昇し、5カ月連続で上昇した。運輸・倉庫が2.0%上昇し、このうちトラック貨物輸送は3.9%上昇した。 PPI全体の前月比の伸びは鈍化したものの、幅広い分野で物価上昇が続いていることが示された。 ■12月会合で0.5%利上げの可能性も CNBCによると、投資家は12月8〜9日に開かれる次回FOMCで0.25%の利上げを既に織り込んでいる。現在の政策金利（フェデラルファンド金利）の誘導目標は3.75〜4.00%で、0.25%の利上げなら4.00〜4.25%となる。 FRBのクリストファー・ウォラー理事は10日、ロンドンでの講演で、12月会合では0.25%の利上げを支持すると表明したうえで、10月の消費者物価指数（CPI）で食品・エネルギーを除くコア指数の上昇率が過去2カ月と同様に前月比0.3%程度かそれ以上となれば、0.5%の利上げを検討すべきだとの考えを示した。ウォラー理事は「0.25%の利上げにとどめれば我々の信認を危険にさらすことになる。それは私が進んで取りたいリスクではない」と述べた。 BLSが10日に発表した10月のCPIは市場予想をやや上回った。前月比の上昇率は0.4%で、9月の0.6%に続いて上昇した。食品・エネルギーを除くコア指数は0.3%上昇した。 エネルギーは9月の5.2%上昇に続き、10月は0.7%上昇した。住居費は0.3%上昇し、CPI全体の前月比上昇の3割超を占めた。食品も0.5%上昇した。 10月のPPIは市場予想をやや下回り、CPIはやや上回った。ただ、卸売物価の前年同月比の伸びは約4年ぶりの高水準にあり、前月比の伸びが鈍化するなかでも物価上昇圧力が続いていることを示している。 ノースライト・アセット・マネジメントのクリス・ザッカレリ最高投資責任者（CIO）はCNBCに対し、「本日のPPIは依然として高すぎるものの、改善の兆しも見られる。ただ、CPIが既にFRBの許容範囲を外れているため、12月のFRBの対応を変える可能性は低い」と述べた。

records.title: 米国、ＡＩによる雇用市場の「深刻な短期的混乱」に備えを＝バーＦＲＢ理事
records.excerpt: ＡＩによる深刻な雇用混乱に備えを、格差拡大の可能性も＝バーＦＲＢ理事(ロイター) - Yahoo!ファイナンス ニューストップ AIトピックス ヘッドライン 新着 株つぶやき 日本株 決算速報 市況・概況 経済総合 FX 外国株 コラム 情報提供元 やさしい投資 企業発見特集 VIP倶楽部を詳しく見る（月額2,838円） ポートフォリオ ログインしてポートフォリオを表示 トップ ニュース 経済総合 ＡＩによる深刻な雇用混乱に備えを、格差拡大の可能性も＝バーＦＲＢ理事 ＡＩによる深刻な雇用混乱に備えを、格差拡大の可能性も＝バーＦＲＢ理事 11/13 0:52 配信 写真はバーＦＲＢ理事。4月14日、米ワシントンで撮影。REUTERS/Evan Vucci（ロイター） Howard Schneider [ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事は１２日、人工知能（ＡＩ）によって雇用市場に「深刻な短期的混乱」が生じるリスクに米国は備えるべきだとの見解を示した。ＡＩの‌普及速度によっては、労働者が大規模に職を失い、投資家側に富が偏る形で⁠格差が拡大する可能性があるとした。 バー氏の発言は、ＡＩの影響を予測するものではなく、ＡＩがもたらす社会的な緊張への備えを提言するものだ。先週の中間選挙では、ＡＩ関連インフラの急速な整備​に対する反発が結果に大きく影響した。ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が任命した作業部会（タスクフォース）は、ＡＩが経済に及ぼす影響を検討するため、１６日にサンフランシスコで公開‌討論会を開く予定。 バー氏はイエール大学での講演原稿で、ＡＩの影響については依然として不透明だと指摘。ＡＩがどのような影響をもたらすかは、企業間の競争が続き、かつてのインターネットのよう‌に、ＡＩが時間の経過とともに「安価かつ広く普‌及したコモディティー（商品）となり、その恩恵が広く共有される」​ようになるかどうかに大きく左右されると述べた。 一方、成功を収める一握りの企業の所有者や投資家に市場支配‌力が集中する可能性もある。この場合、恩恵は労働を代替する資本の所有者に集中し、国民所得に占める労働所得の割合は低下を続け‌ることになる。 労働分配率は、国の生産​活動から生じた所得のうち、企業所有者や投資家の利益・株式収入ではなく、‌労働者の賃金にどの程度回るかを示す大まかな指標。第２次世界大戦から今世紀初めまではおおむね６０─６５％で安定していたが、２０２６年第２・四⁠半期には過去最低の５２．８％に低下した。 バー氏は「ＡＩには、過去の先端技術の進歩と同様、市場支配力の集中を強める特性があると考える研究者もいる」と指摘した。 また、これまでのところ労働者がＡＩに置き換えられる動きは「比較的少なく」、ＡＩが需要を押し上げ、⁠雇用を増やしていることを示す証拠さえあると説明。ただ、雇用​への影響はなお定まってお‌らず、とりわけ中小企業が事業拡大に向けてＡＩを引き続き利用できるかどうかに左右されるとの見方を示した。 「恩恵がどの程度共有されるかは誰にも分からない」とし「一部の分野では、特に若年層や経験の浅い労⁠働者について、ＡＩが労働を代替し得る兆候が既に見られる。労働市場の変化が急速に進めば、労⁠働者の適応は難しくなり、大きな混乱が生じる可能性がある。市場支配力の集中は格差拡大を促す一因となり、⁠アメリカンドリームを揺るがしかねない」と述べた。 ウォーシュ氏は、ＡＩが生産性を向上させ、インフレ率を低下させる可能性にたびた‌び言及し⁠ている。 ただ、そうした恩恵がいつ現れるかは不透明だ。バー氏は、ＡＩ企業がデータセンターや、そ​れに必要な膨大な計算資源に数兆ドルを投じる中、これまでのところＡＩ導入の主な影響は物価を押し上げることだったとの認識を示した。 ロイター 最近見た銘柄 ヘッドライン マーケット指標 世界の指数 FX・為替情報 アメリカの新車販売価格の平均が801万円。日本331万円。物価や年収も日本の3倍！ どう考える？ 2026年11月15日 [ 最新情報 ] 今年になってアメリカやヨーロッパに行ったことがある人なら御存知の通り、食事代やホテル代など滞在費は日本の3倍だと思えば間違いない。年収も3倍といったイメージ。日本の平均年収478万円という生活レベルであればアメリカだと1500万円くらい貰っているワケ。したがって新車販売価格の平均が801万円でも（日本は331万円）問題なし。アメリカ人が日本に来たら何でも安い。 逆に考えたら日本でクルマ作って欧米に輸出したら日本で売るより3倍利益が出ると言うことになる。実際は関税などのハードルが高くなってきているため素直に3倍にならないものの、それでも2倍利益出ると考えていいだろう。ここにきてホンダやマツダや日産の決算が上振れしているのは、超円安で大笑いするほどウハウハだからだ。神風が吹きまくっていると考えていい。 こんなタイミングでトヨタは海外から年間15万台規模で日本で販売するクルマを輸入する。ノア／ヴォクとランドクルーザーFJですね。トヨタの日本販売台数は150万台規模なので10％を海外から持ってくる。普通に考えたら損だ。一方、日本からの輸出を増やそうとしているメーカーもあるようだ。トヨタを除き日本の工場は生産余力を残す。輸出すればウハウハ儲かるし。 長い前置きになった。問題は「今の円安がいつまで続くか？」である。欧米の物価を考えたら円が2倍の1ドル80円になっても釣り合わない。実際、日本が景気良かった1990年代は日本とアメリカの物価はイーブンだった。その後アメリカは物価がジワジワ上がっていく。日本の場合、物価も収入も変わらない。日本で暮らしているから気がつかないだけである。 もちろん今の「物価3分の1」が続けば問題なし。でも明らかにおかしいことだと思うべきである。あっという間に1ドル＝120円になってもおかしくない。そうなったら海外からクルマを輸入してるトヨタは儲かり、日本から海外に輸出しているメーカーは崖っぷちに立たされる。本来なら本田宗一郎さんの格言通り「需要のあるところで生産する」がリスクの無い経営だ。 だからこそ日本のメーカーの中でブッチギリに早いタイミングで海外進出している。アメリカ、ベトナム、ブラジルの奥地であるマナウスにまで工場を作った。輸出ウハウハは自動車産業だけに限らない。1ドルが100円になっても生き延びられる経営戦略を持つことが重要だと思う。といった危機管理能力を持たない企業はやがてくるだろう円高で厳しい状況になる。 < おすすめ記事> 合わせて読みたいおすすめの記事: records.title: 「1個1000円超え」アメリカで急速に進むインフレとドーナツの価格上昇
records.excerpt: 「1個1000円超え」アメリカで急速に進むインフレとドーナツの価格上昇 ドーナツ1000円超 米の物価事情 パジメ | Pajime 2026年11月14日 22時0分 YouTube チャンネル「パジメ | Pajime」が、「インフレが高騰しすぎた世界線の アメリカ は ドーナツ が1000円超えました」と題した動画を公開しました。 アメリカ ・ カリフォルニア 在住のパジメらが、現地のリアルなインフレ事情を体感しつつ、独自の配達企画「 Uber J」で仲間たちにウェットスーツを届ける様子が収められています。 動画の序盤、パジメの仲間であるジェイが「新しい仕事始めました」と切り出し、 SAP ERAウェットスーツを配達する「 Uber J」の活動を宣言します。配達の道中、小腹を空かせた2人は「DUCK DONUTS」に立ち寄ります。 ドーナツ が1個1000円を超える価格設定に、パジメは「 ドーナツ が1個1000円の時代」とインフレを実感する様子を見せました。 ジェイはベーコン、チーズ、卵を挟みメープルシロップをかけた ドーナツ サンドを注文し、「新しい時代到来しましたね」と絶賛しながら頬張ります。パジメもソーセージ入りの ドーナツ サンドを実食し、「メープルシロップの甘さとベーコンのしょっぱさが違うところにある」「脳がバグる」と複雑な味わいに驚きつつも、「なぜか美味しい」と食レポを披露しました。また、雨の中でセブンイレブンの ドーナツ を頬張るジェイが「こっちが本番」と笑顔を見せる お茶 目な場面も登場します。 終盤では、夜の街を車で駆け巡り、待っていた仲間たちへ直接ウェットスーツを配達します。無事に受け取った友人たちの喜ぶ姿を見て、ジェイは「人の笑顔を届ける仕事」と語り、大満足で企画を締めくくりました。 アメリカ のリアルな 物価 事情や、自由でユーモアあふれる彼らのライフスタイルは、現地の空気感を存分に伝えてくれます。 カリフォルニア の日常を覗き見できる動画を、ぜひチェックしてみてはいかがでしょうか。 この様子は、パジメの YouTube チャンネル「パジメ | Pajime」で公開中の動画「インフレが高騰しすぎた世界線の アメリカ は ドーナツ が1000円超えました」で詳しく見ることができる。 アメリカ 生活のリアルが気になる人は、ぜひ動画もチェックしてほしい。 YouTubeの動画内容 00:18 「Uber J」始動！SAPERAウェットスーツを配達 03:05 インフレ実感！1個1000円超えのドーナツ店へ 06:19 脳がバグる？甘じょっぱいドーナツサンドを実食 10:43 セブンイレブンのドーナツに「こっちが本番」 13:43 配達完了！仲間たちへ笑顔を届ける夜 この記事は、動画を投稿したチャンネルが、その動画で伝えた内容を「livedoor ECHOES」を使ってまとめたものです。公開前に同チャンネルによる確認を経ています。 記事の作成方法 みんなの感想は？

records.title: Arthur Hayes Says Fed Rate Hikes Will Prompt Wealthy Investors To Buy More Bitcoin, Real Estate, Watches And Wine
records.excerpt: Higher Federal Reserve rates are supposed to tighten money, but they are giving wealthy investors extra cash to spend on Bitcoin (BTC), real estate, watches, and wine, Flop Labs CEO Arthur Hayes said.In an interview on Saturday with The Rollup podcast, Hayes made the case that higher rates don't dr… Arthur Hayes Says Fed Rate Hikes Will Prompt Wealthy Investors To Buy More Bitcoin, Real Estate, Watches And Wine 2 min read BTCUSD Key points: Arthur Hayes said that Fed rate hikes are not taking money out of the financial system but rather adding to it. He believes a rise in interest on bank reserves and Treasury bills by a quarter point each year would bring in liquidity of about $25 billion each year. He asked crypto investors to watch how much fiat money there is, not interest rates. Higher Federal Reserve rates are supposed to tighten money, but they are giving wealthy investors extra cash to spend on Bitcoin (BTC), real estate, watches, and wine, Flop Labs CEO Arthur Hayes said. In an interview on Saturday with The Rollup podcast, Hayes made the case that higher rates don't drain money from the financial system the way many investors believe. Every hike actually adds to it, he said. How Hikes Add Liquidity Banks have about $3 trillion in reserves at the Fed, he said, and the Fed pays interest on those funds, Hayes said. Hayes reckons a 25-basis-point hike would add about $7.5 billion a year to bank income. The same goes for Treasury bills. These short-term US government debt securities pay interest that moves with the Fed’s policy rate. There’s about $7 trillion of them out there, Hayes said. He estimated a quarter-point hike would cost holders $17 billion more in interest a year. Hayes estimated the boost at about $25 billion per hike. “I estimate that for every 25 basis point hike, you raise $25 billion of extra liquidity,” he said. Investors Get A Raise Most of that money goes to banks and wealthy investors, Hayes said. They don’t have to spend it on everyday goods, he added, so they put it into more financial assets. People invest in hard assets to preserve their purchasing power, he said. “You go and buy more of it because you just got a raise from the Fed,” Hayes said. The effect is most noticeable in economies with a lot of debt, and where borrowing is mostly short-term, he said. In those economies, he said, raising rates to fight inflation ends up adding to it. He cited studies of Brazil in the 1980s as evidence. The Fed raised its benchmark rate a quarter-point in September to a range of 3.75% to 4%, which was the first hike by the central bank since July 2023. One more hike before year-end was penciled in by Fed officials. Quantity Over Price Of Money Hayes said interest rates, or the price of money, get too much focus in the market. The larger question for crypto investors, Hayes pointed to, is how much fiat money there is and how fast it is growing. He also brushed aside concerns about rising US bond yields. “The AI companies are building God, and therefore you don’t care what the interest rate is,” Hayes said. He added that the U.S. government will keep borrowing money as long as it needs to. Hayes said that Europe, and especially France, have a lot more debt than the U.S. Retail Users Remain Bearish Bitcoin’s price slipped to $62,100 on early Sunday, its lowest level since August. records.label: bankingjournal.aba.com
records.title: Fed announces 2027 pricing for payment services, FOMC schedule
records.excerpt: The Federal Reserve this week announced upcoming pricing for payment services the Federal Reserve Banks provide to banks and credit unions, such as the clearing of checks, automated clearing house transactions, instant payments, and wholesale payment and settlement services. The changes are effective Jan. 1, 2027. The Fed expects to recover 101.5% of actual and imputed expenses in 2027, including the return on equity that would have been earned if a private-sector firm provided the services, the central bank said. Overall, price changes for 2027 will result in an estimated 1.4% average price increase for established, mature services. The Fed also announced the 2027 Federal Open Market Committee meetings schedule, with one change from previous years. The FOMC will hold eight meetings next year, but the Oct. 26-27 meeting will be dedicated to monetary policy discussion with no votes expected.

records.title: Ready to host another World Cup? Mexico-US-Costa Rica-Jamaica joint bid for 2031 women's tournament likely
records.excerpt: Title: Ready to host another World Cup? Mexico-US-Costa Rica-Jamaica joint bid for 2031 women’s tournament likely URL Source: http://mexiconewsdaily.com/lifestyle/ready-host-another-world-cup-mexico-us-canada-jamaica-joint-bid-for-2031-likely/ Final URL: https://mexiconewsdaily.com/lifestyle/ready-host-another-world-cup-mexico-us-canada-jamaica-joint-bid-for-2031-likely/ Published Time: 2026-11-14T00:15:03+00:00 Markdown Content: Mexico appears set to host another World Cup in less than five years after FIFA green lighted a joint hosting bid of which the Mexican Soccer Federation is a part. FIFA, soccer’s international governing body, announced on Wednesday that the bid to host the 2031 Women’s World Cup submitted jointly by Mexico, the United States, Jamaica and Costa Rica “has a strong foundation” and will be voted on at the Extraordinary FIFA Congress on Nov. 23. ![Image 1: Corona Estadio in Torreon](https://mexiconewsdaily.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Tsmmundialsub17.jpg) Mexico’s three host cities for the 2026 men’s World Cup — Mexico City, Guadalajara and Monterrey — will host again, but there will be a fourth host city: Torreón, Coahuila. If approved (as the lone bid, it is expected to pass with little difficulty), it would mark the second FWWC to be hosted jointly after Australia and New Zealand co-hosted the 2023 tournament. The Congress will also be considering the joint bid to host the 2035 FIFA Women’s World Cup (FWWC) submitted by England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. [![Image 2](https://mexiconewsdaily.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Banner-728x90px.jpg)](https://mndkids.com/) Next year’s FWWC is to be hosted by Brazil and will feature 32 teams and 64 matches. The 2031 tournament will be expanded to include 48 teams and 104 games. The joint 2031 bid proposes 20 host stadiums across the four countries, with 14 in the United States, four in Mexico and one each in Jamaica and Costa Rica. Mexico’s proposed host cities are Mexico City (Estadio Azteca), Guadalajara (Estadio Akron), Monterrey (Estadio BBVA-Bancomer) and Torreón, Coahuila (Estadio Corona). [![Image 3](https://mexiconewsdaily.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Banner-728x90px-1.png)](https://mexiconewsdaily.com/?addrop_go=678363.23915.aHR0cHM6Ly9tZXhpY29uZXdzZGFpbHkuY29tL3JlZ2lzdGVyLz9sZXZlbF9pZD04.0c4a88761a35eada0846) Following a thorough assessment of the proposal, including inspection visits to the prospective host countries, [FIFA published an evaluation report](https://digitalhub.fifa.com/asset/d2f5f31d-14c9-4e06-8526-090446070a54/FIFA-Women-s-World-Cup-2031-Bid-Evaluation-Report.pdf) indicating that the bid exceeded its minimum requirements. “While certain commitments require further engagement, there is a sound basis for confidence that continued dialogue and collaboration with the relevant government agencies should support the successful organization and delivery of the tournament,” FIFA said. [![Image 4](https://mexiconewsdaily.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Banner-728x90px.png)](https://mexiconewsdaily.com/subscribe/) In endorsing the bid, FIFA acknowledged the success of this year’s men’s World Cup which Mexico and the U.S. co-hosted alongside Canada. FIFA also praised Mexico’s “longstanding record as a FIFA host, having staged the FIFA World Cup in 1970 and 1986, the FIFA Confederations Cup in 1999 and multiple youth competitions, including the FIFA U-20 World Cup 1983 and FIFA U-17 World Cup 2011.” The technical evaluation focused on “defined priority areas, including the event vision, infrastructure, services and commercial considerations” as well as FIFA Fan Festival sites, while the risk assessment considered “safety and security, sustainability, human rights and environmental protection.” As co-host, Mexico’s women’s team would be participating in its fourth FWWC after qualifying for the 1999, 2011 and 2015 tournaments. The El Tri Femenil also participated in [the unofficial 1971 Women’s World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1971_Women%27s_World_Cup) hosted by Mexico. The first FWWC was held in 1991. _With reports from_[_Reuters_](https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/fifa-clears-joint-bids-2031-2035-womens-world-cups-2026-11-11/)_,_[_Fox Sports_](https://www.foxsports.com/articles/soccer/fifa-releases-evaluation-reports-for-the-2031-and-2035-womens-world-cup)_,_[_FIFA_](https://inside.fifa.com/tournament-organisation/media-releases/bid-evaluation-reports-2031-2035-womens-world-cup)_and_[_ESPN_](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50456267/usa-uk-womens-world-cup-bids-cleared-fifa-vote)

records.title: Bessent says the Fed should not raise rates too much into an energy supply shock
records.excerpt: Title: Bessent says the Fed should not raise rates too much into an energy supply shock URL Source: http://mlq.ai/news/bessent-says-the-fed-should-not-raise-rates-too-much-into-an-energy-supply-shock/ Final URL: https://mlq.ai/news/bessent-says-the-fed-should-not-raise-rates-too-much-into-an-energy-supply-shock/ Published Time: 2026-11-14T22:53:23.170166-05:00 Markdown Content: Key points * Bessent on CNBC, Nov. 13: "I think that to hike too much into an energy supply shock when it's coming down, these are very noisy numbers"; he cited gasoline below $4, crude down $20 and diesel down 10% [[1]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/cnbc-excerpts-us-treasury-secretary-scott-bessent-speaks-with-cnbcs-squawk-box-today.html). * He told Reuters he would not tell the Fed what to do but that "they should have an open mind" [[2]](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/us-treasury-chief-says-fed-140232568.html). * Goolsbee said services inflation is "one of the more troubling aspects" of recent reports and that the Fed is not yet on a path back to 2% [[2]](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/us-treasury-chief-says-fed-140232568.html). Markets fully price a quarter-point hike at both the December and January meetings, according to Reuters as cited by 24/7 Wall St [[3]](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/14/bessent-tells-the-fed-not-to-hike-too-much/). ![Image 1: Bessent says the Fed should not raise rates too much into an energy supply shock](https://mlq.ai/media/news_images/bessent-says-the-fed-should-not-raise-rates-too-much-into-an-energy-supply-shock.jpg) Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the Federal Reserve should be careful about raising interest rates too far in response to an energy price shock that he said is already fading. "I think that to hike too much into an energy supply shock when it's coming down, these are very noisy numbers," Bessent said on CNBC's Squawk Box on Friday, Nov. 13. "Last week's the numbers that got published for October is a noisy number" [[1]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/cnbc-excerpts-us-treasury-secretary-scott-bessent-speaks-with-cnbcs-squawk-box-today.html). He pointed to fuel prices: "with gasoline down below $4, crude down $20, diesel down 10% thus far, then we're going to get a benign number likely next week," he said, adding that "the Fed's supposed to look into the future, not look in the rearview mirror" [[1]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/cnbc-excerpts-us-treasury-secretary-scott-bessent-speaks-with-cnbcs-squawk-box-today.html). Bessent also said, according to Reuters, "I'm not going to tell the Fed what to do. I am going to say they should have an open mind," and that reversing course dramatically because of an energy supply shock "isn't something that I would do if I were on the Fed" [[2]](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/us-treasury-chief-says-fed-140232568.html). ## Fed officials point to services inflation Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee, also speaking on CNBC, said: "I respect the secretary and I am trying to figure out the same thing he is trying to figure out" [[2]](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/us-treasury-chief-says-fed-140232568.html). He said "services inflation, which is probably not coming from tariffs or oil, is one of the more troubling aspects" of recent inflation reports, and that the Fed "has definitely got work to do to continue to reestablish its credibility." Asked whether inflation is on a path back to the Fed's 2% target, he said: "My feeling right now is we are not" [[2]](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/us-treasury-chief-says-fed-140232568.html). San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly has said a hike is likely given recent inflation data, pointing to services inflation excluding housing, which does not depend on oil, 24/7 Wall St reported [[3]](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/14/bessent-tells-the-fed-not-to-hike-too-much/). Some officials have discussed a larger-than-usual half-point increase at the Dec. 8-9 meeting, according to Reuters [[2]](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/us-treasury-chief-says-fed-140232568.html). MLQ.ai has covered [Daly's comments](https://mlq.ai/news/san-francisco-feds-daly-says-ai-is-reducing-the-need-to-hire-not-displacing-workers-as-she-leans-toward-more-rate-hikes/) and [Boston Fed President Susan Collins on Saturday](https://mlq.ai/news/feds-collins-backs-gradual-rate-hikes-and-calls-inflation-and-jobs-risks-two-sided/). ## Where rates stand The Fed raised its target range by a quarter point to 3.75% to 4% effective Sept. 17 and held it in October [[3]](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/14/bessent-tells-the-fed-not-to-hike-too-much/). Markets are fully pricing a quarter-point increase at both the December and January meetings, according to Reuters as cited by 24/7 Wall St [[3]](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/14/bessent-tells-the-fed-not-to-hike-too-much/). Our explainer covers [why the Fed is weighing a December hike](https://mlq.ai/news/why-the-fed-is-weighing-a-december-rate-hike-the-data-the-votes-and-what-a-half-point-move-would-mean/). The minutes of the October meeting are due on Wednesday, Nov. 18. ## Further sources This article was produced by MLQ.ai's AI newsroom and checked against primary sources such as company filings, official releases and court documents. records.excerpt: US stock futures moved lower on Friday as investors monitored developments at Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA), assessed financial forecasts from Cisco Systems (NASDAQ:C... US Futures Slip as Nvidia Leadership Transition Draws Attention, While Cisco and Applied Materials Issue Higher Forecasts: Dow Jones, S&P, Nasdaq, Wall Street Fiona Craig Fri, 13 November 2026 at 2:55 am GMT-7 4 min read NVDA CSCO AMAT ^DJI ^NDX Wall Street sign ©Rawpixel US stock futures moved lower on Friday as investors monitored developments at Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA), assessed financial forecasts from Cisco Systems (NASDAQ:CSCO) and Applied Materials (NASDAQ:AMAT), and awaited further economic data that could influence Federal Reserve interest rate expectations. At 03:01 ET (08:01 GMT), Nasdaq 100 futures declined 74 points, or 0.3%, while S&P 500 futures fell five points, equivalent to 0.1%. Dow Jones futures were largely unchanged. The movements followed the departure of Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang, which has prompted questions about the company's management transition and future direction. Nvidia shares fell more than 4% on Thursday following reports concerning Huang's personal conduct and alleged associations with individuals linked to Chinese intelligence. The allegations have not been independently verified. The developments have also attracted attention from US lawmakers. According to Politico, Senate Banking Committee Chairman Tim Scott requested that Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick testify in December regarding companies allegedly involved in transferring Nvidia's advanced processors to China despite US export restrictions. Nvidia has appointed Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress as interim chief executive while its board searches for a permanent replacement. President Donald Trump has suggested former Apple executive Tim Cook as a potential candidate for the position. The management transition comes ahead of Nvidia's quarterly earnings announcement next week, when the company is expected to provide updated financial results and business guidance. Nvidia's market value has declined substantially during November, with the original market report estimating a reduction approaching $1 trillion. Elsewhere, Asian equity markets recorded losses, while government bonds in the United States, Japan and Australia also declined. Oil prices increased following comments from President Trump indicating that the United States no longer required a peace agreement with Iran. Cisco Raises Full-Year Forecast After Reporting $18.1 Billion in Revenue Cisco Systems (NASDAQ:CSCO) increased its full-year financial guidance after reporting fiscal second-quarter revenue of approximately $18.1 billion, exceeding analyst expectations. The networking equipment manufacturer also issued a current-quarter sales forecast above market estimates. Demand for networking infrastructure supporting data centres and artificial intelligence applications contributed to the company's financial performance. Cisco has been expanding its AI-related product portfolio while competing with suppliers including Hewlett Packard Enterprise and Broadcom. Orders increased 21% from the corresponding period a year earlier, compared with growth of 35% in the previous quarter. The moderation in order growth came as policymakers in the United States continued to debate the pace of data centre development. Some Democratic candidates elected during the midterm elections have supported measures to limit further expansion. Cisco shares declined in extended trading following the results. Applied Materials Expects First-Quarter Revenue of Approximately $11.1 Billion Applied Materials (NASDAQ:AMAT) forecast fiscal first-quarter revenue of approximately $11.10 billion, with a possible variation of $500 million above or below that figure. The projection exceeded the $10.89 billion consensus estimate reported by Reuters, citing LSEG data. The semiconductor equipment manufacturer also reported fourth-quarter adjusted earnings of $4.16 per share, ahead of analyst forecasts. Revenue from the company's semiconductor systems business increased 64% to $8 billion, reflecting demand for equipment used in chip production. Investment in manufacturing capacity for artificial intelligence-related semiconductors remains an important component of demand for the company's products. Chief Executive Gary Dickerson told analysts during the earnings conference call that 2027 would be "another record year for the market and Applied." Applied Materials shares edged lower in after-hours trading, although the stock had advanced more than 41% since the beginning of 2026. Microsoft Reports Continued Disruptions to Outlook and Teams Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) said it was continuing efforts to restore access to its Outlook and Teams platforms after a service disruption extended into a second day. The company implemented additional measures across its Microsoft 365 services but reported that some technical changes had not produced the expected improvements. "We've monitored the status of the changes applied to improve serviceability and confirmed they're not taking as expected," Microsoft stated in a social media update. Users across several regions reported difficulties accessing Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Outlook and Teams. The disruption affected customers in Asia-Pacific, the Americas and other international markets. Microsoft shares traded lower outside regular market hours. Gold Recovers from 13-Month Low as US Inflation Data Remains in Focus Gold prices rose on Friday after falling to their lowest level in 13 months during the previous session. Spot gold gained 0.4% to $3,902.22 per ounce, returning above $3,900, although prices remained more than 4% lower for the week. The weekly decline followed higher-than-expected US consumer inflation figures and statements from Federal Reserve officials indicating support for tighter monetary policy. Rising US Treasury yields and a stronger dollar have also influenced demand for the precious metal. Financial markets were considering the possibility of another Federal Reserve interest rate increase in December, including a potential 50-basis-point adjustment. Investors were awaiting the US Producer Price Index report for additional information on wholesale inflation. The data, together with forthcoming comments from Federal Reserve officials and Nvidia's scheduled earnings announcement, was expected to remain a focus for market participants. records.title: Stock Market Midday, Nov. 13: Nasdaq Plunges as Nvidia Turmoil Deepens and Treasury Yields Hit 5%
records.excerpt: Markets came under renewed pressure Friday as rising Treasury yields and uncertainty surrounding the AI industry sparked a rotation out of technology stocks and into defensive sectors. Wall Street extended its losses on Friday, November 13, as mounting uncertainty surrounding Nvidia ( NVDA -2.01% ) and rising Treasury yields fueled a sharp sell-off in technology stocks. As of 11:31 a.m. ET, the Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC -0.91% ) led major indexes lower, falling 1.45% to 24,998, while the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC -0.40% ) declined 0.82% to 7,530. The Dow Jones Industrial Average ( ^DJI +0.10% ) proved more resilient, slipping just 0.12% to 52,234 as investors rotated away from high-growth technology companies. Meanwhile, the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield climbed to 5.10%, adding pressure to equity valuations following another round of inflation data. Gold edged 0.13% lower to $3,880.40, while defensive consumer stocks outperformed. Technology and real estate shares suffered some of the steepest losses, highlighting growing concerns about elevated borrowing costs and the outlook for economic growth. Today's biggest moves Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD -8.75% ) plunged 9.89% as selling pressure intensified across the semiconductor industry following the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Cisco Systems ( CSCO -6.24% ) also declined 5.70%, reflecting broader weakness in enterprise technology stocks. Elsewhere, Modine Manufacturing ( MOD +27.86% ) surged 28.41% following reports that Samsung Electronics ( SSNLF +0.00% ) was exploring a potential acquisition of the thermal management company. Nu Holdings ( NU +11.75% ) also bucked the broader market decline, climbing 10.95% as investors favored select financial technology stocks. What this means for investors Friday's sell-off underscores the growing vulnerability of the AI trade to both company-specific uncertainty and tighter financial conditions. Nvidia's leadership transition has raised questions about the future of the industry's dominant chipmaker, while renewed selling in AMD and other semiconductor stocks suggests concerns are spreading across the broader AI supply chain. With Nvidia scheduled to report earnings next week, investors will be looking for reassurance that demand, product development, and customer spending remain intact despite the leadership shakeup. Meanwhile, the 10-year Treasury yield's climb above 5% presents a significant challenge for equity valuations. Higher yields increase the attractiveness of fixed-income investments and raise the cost of financing future growth, particularly for capital-intensive technology companies. Although the rotation toward defensive sectors suggests investors are becoming more cautious, a sustained market recovery will likely depend on stabilizing yields, resilient corporate earnings, and greater clarity surrounding Federal Reserve policy. records.excerpt: Title: US October PPI Below Expectations; Nasdaq Futures Climb; Anthropic IPO Six Times Oversubscribed URL Source: http://finance.biggo.com/news/bc3199d2-bc72-49a5-8c1a-d786474bf20e Final URL: https://finance.biggo.com/news/bc3199d2-bc72-49a5-8c1a-d786474bf20e Published Time: 2026-11-13T18:35:22.000Z Markdown Content: 2026-11-13 18:35 (GMT+0) US October PPI rose 6.5% year-over-year, below the market expectation of 6.6%, while the month-over-month gain of 0.3% also fell short of forecasts. After the data release, futures on all three major US stock indexes jumped, with Nasdaq, Dow and S&P 500 futures each briefly up more than 0.5%, as traders scaled back bets on the extent of Federal Reserve tightening. Meanwhile, AI company Anthropic's IPO drew orders roughly six times the shares available, with the company and its co-founders planning to raise up to $64.4 billion, alongside a $26 billion private placement, with Nvidia agreeing to subscribe for about $10 billion. Anthropic's annualized revenue has reached $81 billion. The IPO is led by Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, is expected to trade on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. ![Image 1: US October PPI Below Expectations; Nasdaq Futures Climb; Anthropic IPO Six Times Oversubscribed](https://img.biggo.com/999Bz-gFjQid_9jpPWjztDOWGZb5Nc-JZABUfPLizAM/fit/1720/0/sm/0/aHR0cHM6Ly9pbWcuYmdvLm9uZS9uZXdzLWltYWdlL2FpX2dlbmVyYXRlZC8yMDI2LTExL2JjMzE5OWQyLWJjNzItNDlhNS04YzFhLWQ3ODY0NzRiZjIwZV8xNzk0NTk1MzYxX2RlZmF1bHQuanBn.webp) On the evening of the 13th Beijing time, US October Producer Price Index (PPI) data was released, with the year-over-year gain coming in below market expectations, sending futures on the three major US stock indexes briefly higher. At the same time, news that the initial public offering (IPO) of AI company Anthropic was heavily oversubscribed added further fuel to premarket trading in tech stocks. Specifically, US October PPI rose 6.5% year-over-year, versus a prior expectation of 6.6% and a previous reading of 6.3%; it rose 0.3% month-over-month, versus an estimate of 0.4%. Core PPI, which excludes food and energy, also rose 0.3% month-over-month, in line with expectations, while the previous reading was revised up to 0.8% from 0.7%. After the data release, Nasdaq futures, Dow futures and S&P 500 futures were each briefly up more than 0.5%. In US premarket trading, most tech stocks strengthened, with Nvidia and Oracle both up more than 2%, Corning up nearly 2%, and Marvell Technology, Coherent, Google, Tesla and Amazon all up more than 1%. The inflation data comes a few weeks before the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting on December 8-9. The market has now fully priced in a 25-basis-point rate hike and sees a low probability that the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) will opt for a 50-basis-point increase. Traders further scaled back bets on the extent of Fed tightening after the data release. **Anthropic IPO Roughly Six Times Oversubscribed** According to Bloomberg, Anthropic's IPO has drawn orders roughly six times the shares available, and with investor interest heating up, the offering is poised to become the largest listing in history. Filings show that the AI company, developer of the Claude model, and its co-founders plan to raise up to $64.4 billion in the IPO and another $26 billion through a concurrent private placement. Combined, the offering would exceed the size of SpaceX's IPO. Banks have told potential investors that Anthropic will prioritize existing backers, and some interested subscribers will ultimately receive smaller allocations than expected. As part of the $26 billion private placement, Nvidia has agreed to subscribe for about $10 billion of Anthropic shares. Anthropic views Nvidia as a strategic partner and has committed to spending tens of billions of dollars on related agreements to secure access to its most advanced chips. The filings also show that as of October 31, Anthropic's annualized revenue stood at $81 billion, up $10 billion from the end of September. It was previously reported that the company's annualized revenue at the end of July was $65 billion. The continued sales growth supports the current debate over whether AI spending is justified. The IPO is led by Goldman Sachs Group and Morgan Stanley, with 20 other banks participating. The stock is expected to trade on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker ANT. **Other Premarket Developments** According to market reports, merger talks between SpaceX and Tesla are making progress, with both boards and their advisers negotiating deal terms and post-merger governance. The two companies could announce a merger as early as December, though they have also discussed the possibility of delaying the announcement until early 2027. Nvidia rose nearly 2% premarket. Reports said some Nvidia employees posted on an internal suggestion box urging the board to fully consider employee views before making major decisions; the post has drawn more than 1,600 comments. Goldman Sachs strategists expect the S&P 500 to rise about 14% over the next 12 months to 8,700 points, and recommend overweighting US and Japanese stocks and underweighting European stocks in 2027. A key reason for the bank's bullish view on US stocks is that, after the selloff in mega-cap tech stocks, valuations of hyperscale cloud service providers are now significantly below historical levels. Chip company Cerebras surged more than 15% premarket. The company's third-quarter core revenue was $230 million, up 70% year-over-year and above the market expectation of $215 million; cloud services revenue rose 272% year-over-year to $145 million. The company also raised its full-year 2026 core revenue guidance to $940 million to $960 million from $880 million to $890 million. Bank of America strategists said global equity funds are attracting record inflows this year, with few investors willing to short. A team led by Michael Harnett wrote in a report that equity exposure has surged, with $1.4 trillion flowing into global funds on an annualized basis. | Indicator | Reported | Market Expectation | Previous | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | US October PPI YoY | 6.5% | 6.6% | 6.3% | | US October PPI MoM | 0.3% | 0.4% | — | | US October Core PPI MoM | 0.3% | 0.3% | 0.8% (revised) | Note: Revisions to previous readings are subject to official US data. **Market Impact** The below-expectation PPI gain eased concerns that a rebound in inflation would force the Federal Reserve to step up tightening, serving as the direct driver of the rise in stock index futures. Meanwhile, Anthropic's massive IPO drawing multiple times the shares available, combined with Nvidia's $10 billion strategic stake, shows that capital's bets on AI infrastructure and the model layer have not cooled. For investors, near-term focus will shift to policy signals from the Federal Reserve's December meeting and whether Anthropic can sustain primary-market enthusiasm after listing. records.excerpt: Title: BMO Launches New ETF Strategies, Including First All Country World Index ETF in Canada to Include Canadian Equities URL Source: http://newsroom.bmo.com/2026-11-13-BMO-Launches-New-ETF-Strategies,-Including-First-All-Country-World-Index-ETF-in-Canada-to-Include-Canadian-Equities Final URL: https://newsroom.bmo.com/2026-11-13-BMO-Launches-New-ETF-Strategies,-Including-First-All-Country-World-Index-ETF-in-Canada-to-Include-Canadian-Equities Markdown Content: BMO Launches New ETF Strategies, Including First All Country World Index ETF in Canada to Include Canadian Equities * _BMO ETF lineup expands with six additional strategies, including five non-index ETFs and a new all country world index ETF_ * _BMO MSCI All Country World Index ETF is the first Canadian-listed ETF designed to replicate the MSCI All Country World Index, which includes Canada_ _1_ * _Introducing two securitized credit ETFs providing access to European and global investment-grade securitized credit_ , /CNW/ -- BMO Asset Management Inc., the manager of the BMO ETFs, today announced the launch of new BMO ETFs set out in the table below (collectively, the "**BMO ETFs**"). Each of the BMO ETFs will offer CAD Units, and BMO European Securitized Credit ETF will offer CAD Units and Hedged Units (collectively, the series of units set out below are referred to as the "**Units**"). "The ETF market continues to evolve as investors seek more targeted ways to build portfolios," said Sara Petrcich, Head of ETFs & Structured Solutions, BMO Global Asset Management. "These new ETFs build on BMO's longstanding commitment to innovation, offering investors additional choice and access to strategies designed to help them pursue their financial goals with confidence." Each of the BMO ETFs has closed its initial offering of Units and will be listed and trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange today. **Name of BMO ETF (English)****Series of Units****Ticker Symbol****Annual Management Fee (%)** BMO MSCI All Country World Index ETF CAD Units ZALL 0.18 BMO European Securitized Credit ETF CAD Units Hedged Units ZESC ZESC.F 0.45 0.45 BMO Fixed Income ETF CAD Units ZFIX 0.15 BMO Global Securitized Credit Hedged to CAD ETF CAD Units ZGSC 0.45 BMO Global Short-Term Discount Bond Hedged to CAD ETF CAD Units ZGDB 0.18 BMO Income ETF CAD Units ZINC 0.15 **Investment Objectives** _BMO MSCI All Country World Index ETF_ BMO MSCI All Country World Index ETF seeks to replicate, to the extent possible, the performance of an index that provides exposure to equity securities of large and mid-capitalization issuers in developed-market and emerging-market countries, net of fees and expenses. BMO MSCI All Country World Index ETF seeks to replicate the performance of the MSCI ACWI Index (the "**Index**") by investing, directly or indirectly, in instruments that have, in the aggregate, investment characteristics similar to the Index or to a subset of the Index Constituents. _BMO European Securitized Credit ETF_ BMO European Securitized Credit ETF seeks to provide income, while preserving capital, through exposure to Investment Grade CLOs and other types of ABS of issuers domiciled primarily in Europe and the UK. In respect of the Hedged Units, BMO European Securitized Credit ETF will also invest in or use derivative instruments to seek to hedge certain European currency exposure back to the Canadian dollar. _BMO Fixed Income ETF_ BMO Fixed Income ETF seeks to provide income through exposure to a diversified portfolio of global fixed income securities. _BMO Global Securitized Credit Hedged to CAD ETF_ BMO Global Securitized Credit Hedged to CAD ETF seeks to provide income, while preserving capital, through exposure to Investment Grade CLOs and other types of ABS of issuers domiciled across the globe. The BMO ETF will seek to hedge certain non-Canadian currency exposure back to the Canadian dollar primarily through investment in hedged units of one or more Underlying Funds as well as by investing in or using derivative instruments to seek to hedge foreign currency exposure back to the Canadian dollar to the extent the BMO ETF is investing directly in unhedged investments. _BMO Global Short-Term Discount Bond Hedged to CAD ETF_ BMO Global Short-Term Discount Bond Hedged to CAD ETF seeks to generate income through exposure to investment grade global corporate fixed income securities that trade near or below par value. BMO Global Short-Term Discount Bond Hedged to CAD ETF will use or invest in derivative instruments to hedge certain non-Canadian currency exposure back to the Canadian dollar. _BMO Income ETF_ BMO Income ETF seeks to provide income and the potential for moderate long-term capital appreciation through exposure to fixed income and equity securities of issuers domiciled across the globe. Further information on BMO ETFs can be found at [www.bmoetfs.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4821844-1&h=379060972&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.bmoetfs.com%2F&a=www.bmoetfs.com). **Disclaimers** Any capitalized term used but not defined in this press release is defined in the BMO ETFs' prospectus. records.title: Canada invests billions in charging infrastructure and grid upgrades
records.excerpt: The Canadian government is investing in the expansion of electric vehicle charging and grid infrastructure with investments of just over $634 million. The new investment should roughly double the more than 50,000 chargers supported through existing programs. The EV charging initiative is further supported by the government’s national electricity strategy with over $50 billion to be invested in doubling the capacity of Canada’s grid by 2050. Politics Canada invests billions in charging infrastructure and grid upgrades The Canadian government is investing in the expansion of electric vehicle charging and grid infrastructure with investments of just over $634 million. The new investment should roughly double the more than 50,000 chargers supported through existing programs. The EV charging initiative is further supported by the government’s national electricity strategy with over $50 billion to be invested in doubling the capacity of Canada’s grid by 2050. Image: Mercedes-Benz North America By Carrie Hampel 14.11.2026 - 14:00 Canada public charging infrastructure ZEVIP LinkedIn Facebook The electric vehicle charging program is tied to $587 million to renew the Zero-Emission Vehicle Infrastructure Program (ZEVIP) . The program had been set to expire next year. If approved by the Canadian Parliament, the renewed funding will be distributed over five years starting in 2027. Another $45 million over five years will go toward charging infrastructure research and development, while $2.2 million will support the federal government’s transition to zero-emission vehicles. Combined, the investments total $634.2 million. The ZEVIP is a fund targeting public EV charging developments, covering up to 50 per cent of project expenses, or 75 per cent of Indigenous-led projects, with caps of up to $2 million per project. If approved by Parliament, the renewed funding is expected to support more than 55,000 additional chargers in what the budget calls “areas where the infrastructure is needed most.” Travis Allan, president and CEO of the Canadian Charging Infrastructure Council (CCIC), told Canadian publication Electric Autonomy , “We’ll be looking to make sure that we have great programs in place to deal with the barriers faced by people living in condos and apartments, public fast charging, which needs to cover major corridors and metropolitan areas, and then also charging for fleets and medium- and heavy-duty vehicles, which make up a major share of transportation emissions.” The funding for EV charging research and development is earmarked for Natural Resources Canada, which would receive the $45 million over five years, also starting in 2027-28. “We’re interested to see how those will be spent because we have so many great companies that are working in and innovating in the charging ecosystem,” said Allan. At the same time, the Canadian government is planning major electrical grid upgrades. Among the biggest elements is an investment of nearly $4 billion over 10 years, starting in 2027-28, for electricity infrastructure expansion, renewable energy and priority grid projects. This includes new funding for the Smart Renewables and Electrification Pathways Program. Here, Natural Resources Canada would also be supplied with $26.4 million over 10 years for data and modelling to guide grid planning. The budget also earmarks $1.6 billion over 10 years with the purpose of modernising the power systems in northern and remote communities. Daniel Breton, president and CEO of Electric Mobility Canada, has said the funding is encouraging, noting the five-year ZEVIP window, which he said can make planning and acquiring financing easier. He also spoke positively of the planned grid upgrades. “It’s one thing to install chargers,” he said. “We have to get the electricity to go to the chargers.” At the same time, Breton expressed disappointment that the new federal budget has not envisaged additional funding for medium- and heavy-duty electric vehicles, EV education or battery recycling. Canada’s Incentives for Medium- and Heavy-Duty Zero-Emission Vehicles (iMHZEV) program already ended on March 15, 2026, with no federal replacement so far. electricautonomy.ca , driveteslacanada.ca , budget.canada.ca Tags Canada public charging infrastructure ZEVIP Grid 0 Comments about „Canada invests billions in charging infrastructure and grid upgrades“ Leave a Reply Cancel reply

records.excerpt: Title: NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA) Given New $240.00 Price Target at BMO Capital Markets URL Source: http://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/analyst-nvidia-nasdaq-nvda-given-new-24000-price-target-at-bmo-capital-markets-2026-11-12/ Final URL: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/analyst-nvidia-nasdaq-nvda-given-new-24000-price-target-at-bmo-capital-markets-2026-11-12/ Published Time: 2026-11-12T17:06:32.8800000Z Markdown Content: NVIDIA ([NASDAQ:NVDA](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/NVDA/) - [Get Free Report](https://www.marketbeat.com/arnreports/ReportTickerOptin.aspx?RegistrationCode=TickerHyperlink&Prefix=NASDAQ&Symbol=NVDA)) had its target price lowered by [BMO Capital Markets](https://www.marketbeat.com/ratings/by-issuer/bmo-capital-markets-stock-recommendations/) from $340.00 to $240.00 in a research note issued on Thursday, Benzinga reports. The brokerage presently has an "outperform" rating on the computer hardware maker's stock. [BMO Capital Markets](https://www.marketbeat.com/ratings/by-issuer/bmo-capital-markets-stock-recommendations/)'s price objective points to a potential upside of 45.56% from the company's previous close. * [Alphabet Escalates AI Chip Rivalry With NVIDIA](https://www.marketbeat.com/articles/alphabet-escalates-ai-chip-rivalry-with-nvidia/) NVDA has been the subject of a number of other research reports. [Wells Fargo & Company](https://www.marketbeat.com/ratings/by-issuer/wells-fargo-co-stock-recommendations/) reduced their target price on NVIDIA from $315.00 to $300.00 and set an "overweight" rating for the company in a research note on Tuesday. [President Capital](https://www.marketbeat.com/ratings/by-issuer/president-capital-stock-recommendations/) increased their price objective on NVIDIA from $295.00 to $330.00 in a report on Thursday, August 27th. [Needham & Company LLC](https://www.marketbeat.com/ratings/by-issuer/needham-company-llc-stock-recommendations/) reduced their price objective on NVIDIA from $300.00 to $200.00 and set a "buy" rating for the company in a research note on Thursday. [Deutsche Bank](https://www.marketbeat.com/ratings/by-issuer/deutsche-bank-stock-recommendations/) reaffirmed a "buy" rating on shares of NVIDIA in a report on Monday, August 31st. Finally, [Rothschild & Co Redburn](https://www.marketbeat.com/ratings/by-issuer/rothschild-co-redburn-stock-recommendations/) upped their target price on NVIDIA from $300.00 to $325.00 in a research report on Thursday, August 27th. Five investment analysts have rated the stock with a Strong Buy rating, forty-one have issued a Buy rating and ten have given a Hold rating to the stock. According to MarketBeat, NVIDIA currently has a consensus rating of "Moderate Buy" and an average price target of $292.20. Get **NVIDIA** alerts: **[Get Our Latest Analysis on NVIDIA](https://www.marketbeat.com/arnreports/ReportTickerOptin.aspx?RegistrationCode=TickerHyperlink&Prefix=NASDAQ&Symbol=NVDA)** ## NVIDIA Stock Down 5.1% * [The AI Debt Bill Is Coming Due, But Biotech Has Revenue to Show for the Boom](https://www.marketbeat.com/articles/the-ai-debt-bill-is-coming-due-but-biotech-has-revenue-to-show-for-the-boom/) Shares of [NVDA stock](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/NVDA/forecast/) traded down $8.86 during trading hours on Thursday, reaching $164.88. 503,974,024 shares of the company's stock were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 154,375,063. NVIDIA has a 1 year low of $148.80 and a 1 year high of $243.37. The stock has a market cap of $3.97 trillion, a PE ratio of 20.86, a PEG ratio of 1.30 and a beta of 2.21. The company has a current ratio of 4.59, a quick ratio of 3.85 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.14. The stock's fifty day moving average price is $217.12 and its two-hundred day moving average price is $204.35. Discover more Read Company News Invest in Stocks Track Stock Market NVIDIA ([NASDAQ:NVDA](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/NVDA/) - [Get Free Report](https://www.marketbeat.com/arnreports/ReportTickerOptin.aspx?RegistrationCode=TickerHyperlink&Prefix=NASDAQ&Symbol=NVDA)) last announced its quarterly earnings data on Wednesday, August 26th. The computer hardware maker reported $2.22 EPS for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $2.09 by $0.13. The firm had revenue of $96.22 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $92.27 billion. NVIDIA had a net margin of 63.66% and a return on equity of 96.04%. NVIDIA's revenue was up 105.9% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period last year, the firm posted $1.05 EPS. Research analysts predict that NVIDIA will post 9.30 EPS for the current year. * [5 AI Heavyweights That Look Too Cheap to Ignore After the Sell-Off](https://www.marketbeat.com/articles/5-ai-heavyweights-that-look-too-cheap-to-ignore-after-the-sell-off/) NVIDIA announced that its Board of Directors has approved a share repurchase program on Monday, September 28th that permits the company to buy back $150 billion in outstanding shares. This buyback authorization permits the computer hardware maker to purchase up to 2.8% of its stock through open market purchases. Share buyback programs are usually a sign that the company's board believes its shares are undervalued. ## Insider Activity In other news, EVP Timothy S. Teter sold 30,460 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Monday, September 21st. The shares were sold at an average price of $222.80, for a total transaction of $6,786,488.00. Following the sale, the executive vice president directly owned 2,687,660 shares of the company's stock, valued at $598,810,648. This represents a 1.12% decrease in their position. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available through [this link](http://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000169684126000014/xslF345X06/wk-form4_1790196985.xml). The transaction was executed under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. Also, CFO [Colette Kress](https://www.insidertrades.com/nvidia-co-stock/colette-kress) sold 34,918 shares of the firm's stock in a transaction dated Thursday, September 17th. The shares were sold at an average price of $219.05, for a total value of $7,648,787.90. Following the sale, the chief financial officer owned 765,103 shares in the company, valued at $167,595,812.15. This trade represents a 4.36% decrease in their ownership of the stock. Additional details regarding this sale are available in the [official SEC disclosure](http://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000158867026000014/xslF345X06/wk-form4_1789765959.xml). The transaction was executed under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. Insiders sold a total of 1,766,118 shares of company stock valued at $399,450,353 in the last three months. 3.94% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders. ## Hedge Funds Weigh In On NVIDIA A number of large investors have recently bought and sold shares of NVDA. Energy prices have continued to rise because of the unending war in Iran that has pushed diesel costs to a record high. records.excerpt: Title: When Allies Become Vulnerable: U.S.-Canada Tensions and the Future of North American Health Security URL Source: http://natoassociation.ca/when-allies-become-vulnerable-u-s-canada-tensions-and-the-future-of-north-american-health-security/ Final URL: https://natoassociation.ca/when-allies-become-vulnerable-u-s-canada-tensions-and-the-future-of-north-american-health-security/ Markdown Content: Canada and the United States have always maintained one of the world’s most integrated trading relationships, with businesses and industries on both sides of the border relying on cross-border supply [chains](https://www.international.gc.ca/country-pays/us-eu/relations.aspx?lang=eng). This relationship has come under increasing pressure as the United States and Canada have imposed tariffs and countermeasures on one another. For instance, in August 2026, the United States imposed a [50 per cent tariff on $27.6 billion](https://www.canada.ca/en/department-finance/news/2026/08/list-of-products-from-the-united-states-subject-to-counter-tariffs-effective-september-8-2026.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com) worth of Canadian goods, which prompted Canada to introduce matching counter-tariffs dollar for dollar. Given the deep integration of U.S.-Canada trade and production, these tensions have raised concerns about the resilience of critical supply chains, including the distribution of pharmaceutical inputs and medicine. Thus, any changes in trade policy risk creating vulnerabilities beyond economic loss. Overall, the deterioration of the U.S.-Canada relations demonstrates that economic interdependence between allies can become a health-security vulnerability during periods of geopolitical tension. As trade restrictions continue to challenge deeply integrated supply chains, Canada and the United States should treat health security as an element of resilience by strengthening domestic capacity and diversifying critical medical supply chains. **How Economic Interdependence Creates Health-Security Vulnerabilities** The relationship between both nations goes beyond geography and history, but is also tied by extensive trade and investment flows and cross-border supply chains. [The United States](https://www.international.gc.ca/country-pays/us-eu/relations.aspx?lang=eng) is Canada’s largest trading partner in goods and services, while Canada is the United States’ second-largest trading partner. [Almost $2.6 billion](https://www.international.gc.ca/country-pays/us-eu/relations.aspx?lang=eng) worth of goods and services crossed the border daily in 2024. More specifically, Canada and the U.S. have a substantial and highly interconnected pharmaceutical trade relationship. In 2025, the[U.S. accounted for 70.4%](https://ised-isde.canada.ca/site/canadian-life-science-industries/en/canadian-life-science-industries/biopharmaceuticals-and-pharmaceuticals/pharmaceutical-sector-profile)of Canadian pharmaceutical exports and 32.4% of imports. Given the recent economic tensions between the two, this level of interdependence creates vulnerabilities for both economies as tariffs and other trade restrictions could disrupt access to essential products and create cross-border policy uncertainty. Canada relies heavily on pharmaceutical imports, with [56% of finished generic drugs](https://www.cma.ca/healthcare-for-real/where-do-canadas-medications-come-and-who-makes-them) imported during 2019–2021. Generic drugs contain the same active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) as their brand-name counterparts. The [U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA)](https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/q7a-good-manufacturing-practice-guidance-active-pharmaceutical-ingredients?utm_source=chatgpt.com#P1422_111232) defines APIs as substances responsible for producing a drug’s intended therapeutic effect. However, domestic pharmaceutical manufacturing does not eliminate Canada’s reliance on foreign inputs, including imported APIs and raw materials. According to a [2022 study by EY Canada](https://canadiangenerics.ca/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/02.22-EY-CGPA-Capacity-Study_FINAL-1.pdf) for the Canadian Generic Pharmaceutical Association, Canada relies on trade relationships with India, the United States, and Europe to secure APIs and finished-dose products. This dependence on international supply chains means that Canada’s pharmaceutical security does not rely solely on its domestic manufacturing capacity. Disruptions to trade, transportation, or access to foreign inputs could affect both the availability of imported medicines and Canada’s ability to manufacture medicines domestically. **Resilience Does Not Mean Self-Sufficiency** While foreign dependence on trade has revealed the potential vulnerabilities that Canada can face, the country cannot combat this by manufacturing every pharmaceutical product domestically. This would be unrealistic given the size of the Canadian pharmaceutical market which represents about [2% of global drug and medical device sales.](https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/drugs-health-products/drug-products/drug-shortages/plan-2024-2028.html) API manufacturing is largely outsourced even if the final manufacturing of a drug might be done in Canada. Most pharmaceutical companies purchase [APIs internationally according to Health Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/environment/weather/climatechange/climate-plan/net-zero-emissions-2050/challenge/primers/pharmaceutical-companies.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com). Therefore, rather than pharmaceutical self sufficiency, Canada must prioritize strategic domestic capacity. Strategic domestic capacity must be strengthened specifically in areas where disruptions can pose the greatest risk to public health. For instance, [Health Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/drugs-health-products/drug-products/drug-shortages/critical-vulnerable-list.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)provides a list of medicines that are already vulnerable to supply disruptions. Antibiotics including [amoxicillin and penicillin G](https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/drugs-health-products/drug-products/drug-shortages/critical-vulnerable-list.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com) are useful examples of drugs that are critical and vulnerable to shortages. Strengthening domestic production of certain medicines or their key inputs would provide Canada with greater resilience when international trade or transportation is disrupted, without requiring the country to produce every medicine domestically. In fact, Canada is already taking steps to strengthen domestic capacity and bolster health security. The early start of the [COVID-19 pandemic](https://www.canada.ca/en/innovation-science-economic-development/news/2021/07/the-government-of-canada-announces-biomanufacturing-and-life-sciences-strategy.html) demonstrated the importance of a resilient biopharmaceutical industry, as Canada lacked the flexible biomanufacturing capacity needed to quickly produce a COVID-19 vaccine domestically. As a result, the [federal government](https://www.canada.ca/en/innovation-science-economic-development/news/2021/07/the-government-of-canada-announces-biomanufacturing-and-life-sciences-strategy.html) has been working on rebuilding the domestic biomanufacturing sector through quick strategic actions as well as maintaining a long-term vision to develop sustainable domestic vaccine and therapeutics manufacturing capacity.[Budget 2021 has put $2.2 billion](https://www.canada.ca/en/innovation-science-economic-development/news/2021/07/the-government-of-canada-announces-biomanufacturing-and-life-sciences-strategy.html)to implement the Biomanufacturing and Life Sciences Strategy. [The strategy](https://www.canada.ca/en/innovation-science-economic-development/news/2021/07/the-government-of-canada-announces-biomanufacturing-and-life-sciences-strategy.html) focuses on strengthening the research and talent base of Canadian businesses and projects that addr

records.title: Britain, Canada and Norway combine forces for $10 billion climate push as their state investors target African power, storage and industrial projects
records.excerpt: State investors from Britain, Canada and Norway aim to mobilise $10 billion for climate projects, with African power, storage and industrial investments eligible. African renewable-power, electricity-storage and industrial projects will be eligible, although no continent-specific allocation has been announced. [Photo© Raphael Pouget \Climate Visuals Countdown] State-backed investment institutions from Britain, Canada and Norway aim to support at least $10 billion in climate and energy-transition activity by 2030. The target includes money mobilised from private investors and is not $10 billion in new government funding. African projects will be eligible, but the partners have not announced a continent-specific allocation or named initial recipients. Target sectors include renewable energy, electricity transmission, storage, sustainable fuels and industrial decarbonisation. ADVERTISEMENT Read Also markets Trump faces Carney's refusal to back down as Canada pushes back against U.S. trade demands and Africa's largest economy turns to China markets France risks losing more African allies as rival nations battle to lead the world's largest French-speaking bloc, but Macron has another candidate in mind markets China and Russia lose their grip on Venezuelan oil as US takes control of $12 billion in revenues but faces a billionaire's growing grip on prized African crude British International Investment, FinDev Canada and Norway’s Norfund signed a memorandum of understanding creating the “10by30” initiative on the sidelines of the COP31 climate summit in Antalya, Türkiye. The three development-finance institutions intend to identify investment opportunities together, exchange information on their project pipelines, coordinate due diligence and potentially co-invest in major transactions. Reuters reported that the programme would cover renewable energy , electricity transmission and distribution, energy storage, sustainable fuels and industrial decarbonisation across emerging markets. ADVERTISEMENT Africa is one of the institutions’ established investment regions. However, the entire $10 billion may not be the funding allocated to the continent. No Africa-specific amount, list of countries or first round of projects has been announced. What the $10 billion target means The three organisations expect their separate climate strategies to support at least $10 billion in investment activity over five years. The figure includes capital they hope to attract from private investors. It is therefore not a new $10 billion government grant, nor has the full amount been deposited into a common fund. ADVERTISEMENT The memorandum also does not create a joint investment platform, legal entity or binding financial obligation among the institutions. Each proposed transaction will still be assessed and approved separately under the mandate and governance rules of the institution investing in it. That means the $10 billion is a mobilisation target to be reached by 2030—not money already committed to identified projects. The institutions believe closer cooperation can reduce duplicated work and shorten the time required to assess large infrastructure investments. They will share market information, coordinate their technical and financial reviews and develop common approaches to measuring avoided emissions. British International Investment, FinDev Canada and Norfund launched the “10by30” climate-finance initiative at COP31 in Antalya. [FinDev ] BI Africa ADVERTISEMENT “ Today’s signing brings together three global leaders in climate finance in emerging markets ,” British International Investment chief executive Leslie Maasdorp said. “ Our shared determination is to create the opportunities that will move private capital at an unprecedented scale to where it is needed the most .” Why African projects are positioned to benefit All three institutions already invest in Africa, giving potential projects on the continent a direct route into their combined investment pipelines. British International Investment directed £1.07 billion, approximately $1.4 billion, or 59% of its new commitments, to Africa in 2025. Its portfolio included investments in 899 African companies. ADVERTISEMENT Under its 2026–2031 strategy, the British institution wants at least 40% of its new investments, including those made through British Climate Partners, to qualify as climate finance. Its priorities include renewable electricity, stronger power networks and transition financing for banks and industrial companies in Africa and Asia. Norfund is also heavily exposed to the continent. Approximately 63% of its committed development portfolio was in Africa at the end of 2025, while the continent received 71% of its new development-mandate investments during the year. Its Climate Investment Fund specifically identifies South Africa , Egypt, Tunisia and Morocco among its priority markets. The fund invests in renewable generation, electricity storage and transmission infrastructure intended to replace or avoid fossil-fuel power. FinDev Canada’s investment mandate covers Africa, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and the Caribbean. Its climate portfolio includes renewable energy, storage, grid infrastructure, cleaner transport and sustainable agriculture. ADVERTISEMENT The Canadian institution had signed commitments of $2.72 billion by June 2026, with 47% of its investments classified as climate finance. Earlier in 2026, it committed $100 million to the Africa Finance Corporation for renewable-energy and low-carbon rail projects across the continent. These existing mandates make Africa a documented investment market for all three partners. They do not, however, guarantee that any particular African project will receive financing under the new arrangement. Western governments seek private capital Public development institutions frequently use their own money to reduce the perceived risks of projects and attract commercial banks, pension funds and other private investors. ADVERTISEMENT The three governments are adopting that model because power plants, grids and industrial transition projects in emerging markets often require more capital than public development budgets can provide. FinDev Canada chief executive Lori Kerr said the partners would combine fresh capital, blended-finance products and technical assistance to attract private investors into commercially viable projects capable of delivering substantial emissions reductions. Norfund chief executive Erik Sandersen said cooperation would allow the institutions to deploy their capital and staff more efficiently and accelerate decisions. “ Climate finance needs both scale and speed ,” he said. The initiative could give African developers access to three state-backed institutions through a more coordinated process. But its relevance will ultimately depend on the projects approved, the amount of private capital actually mobilised and how much of the $10 billion reaches African markets.

records.label: finance.biggo.jp
records.title: SKハイニックス、Solidigmの米国上場を撤回…重複上場規制でM&Aにも影響
records.excerpt: Title: SKハイニックス、Solidigmの米国上場を撤回…重複上場規制でM&Aにも影響 URL Source: http://finance.biggo.jp/news/49db7336-e60b-4965-99a8-f93e4c32f071 Final URL: https://finance.biggo.jp/news/49db7336-e60b-4965-99a8-f93e4c32f071 Published Time: 2026-11-13T21:35:16.000Z Markdown Content: SKハイニックスが孫会社であるSolidigmの米国新規株式公開（IPO）検討を中止した。韓国金融当局による重複上場規制の強化が海外子会社の上場を事実上妨げる中、上場を通じた投資回収と資金調達の道が閉ざされた企業が続出している。業界では新事業投資の好機を逃す可能性があるとの懸念とともに、海外の買収・合併（M&A）まで萎縮しかねないとの見方が出ている。 14日の業界関係者によると、最近、韓国国内外での上場を推進していた主要企業が計画を相次いで撤回または保留している。SKハイニックスは既存投資の回収と米国内の新規生産施設確保のためSolidigmの上場を検討してきたが、最近この作業を停止した。会社側は理由として「金融市場の変動性拡大」を挙げたが、韓国金融当局の重複上場規制の基調も一定程度作用したとの分析が出ている。 イ・チャンジン韓国金融監督院長は先月、韓国国会政務委員会の国政監査で、Solidigmの上場推進が重複上場に該当する可能性があると言及した。イ・ジェミョン大統領も今年初め、LSの非上場曾孫会社であるEssex Solutionsの上場推進を取り上げ、厳格な処理を求めた。同社は内外の利害関係者の懸念を反映し、上場申請を撤回した。その後、韓国金融委員会は親会社による子会社の重複上場を原則禁止する制度改善案をまとめ、昨年8月から施行に入った。例外的に認められるには、株主忠実義務に基づく5大義務を履行する必要がある。 SKハイニックスの決定は、海外上場の可能性が取り沙汰される他の系列会社にも波及しかねない。Hyundai MotorのBoston Dynamics、LG電子のBear Roboticsなどが代表例として挙げられる。 業界は、重複上場規制の強化により、上場を通じた大規模な資金調達が事実上封鎖されたと指摘する。チェ・スンジェ世宗大学法学部教授は「企業の新成長動力確保に向けた資金調達の面で否定的な側面がある」とし、「今後、新規上場も萎縮する見通しだ」と述べた。 問題は、資金回収の経路が減ることでM&Aへの誘因も弱まりかねない点だ。クォン・ジェヨル慶熙大学法学専門大学院教授は「SKハイニックスはリスクを取ってインテルのNAND事業部を買収した」とし、「投資資金を回収するには売却か上場が必要だが、選択肢が減った」と指摘した。続けて「今後、海外で良い案件が出ても、企業の立場ではリスクを取って買収・合併に踏み切る理由が減るのではないか」と問い返した。 子会社の上場が難しくなれば、親会社の直接投資や社債発行、金融機関からの借り入れなどが代替案として挙げられる。しかし、高金利で利子負担が大きく、限られた財源で多様な成長動力を確保するのは難しいとの指摘が続く。クォン教授は「企業の立場では社債発行より株式を発行して上場する方が負担が少なく望ましい」とし、「政策的に重複上場を制限すれば、企業の立場では打撃が大きいのは避けられない」と述べた。 一方、政府は同日の資本市場政策懇談会で、M&A活性化を通じた市場正常化への意志を再確認した。イ・ジェミョン大統領は「市場正常化の最大の装置が敵対的M&Aだ」とし、「M&Aを活性化して容易に、多く行えるようにしてこそ市場が正常化する」と述べた。義務公開買い付け制度の買い付け比率については「50%＋1株」以上案に重きを置きつつ、「批判を受けてもパイを大きくする側、M&Aを活性化して市場全体が正常化されることで全ての株主が恩恵を受けるという側に近い」と述べた。 政府がM&A活性化を強調するのとは別に、子会社上場を通じた資金調達の経路は狭まっている。上場を前提とした買収戦略を組んできた企業にとっては、投資回収の時期と新事業推進の日程を組み直さざるを得ない状況だ。
